text.zh: 相关定义：(1) “同步数字体系”（SDH）是一种数字体系，通过在不同类型介质上使用同步传输格式，提供管理、复用和接入各种形式数字业务的手段。该格式以CCITT建议G.703、G.707、G.708、G.709及其他尚待发布的建议所定义的同步传送模块（STM）为基础。“SDH”的第一级速率为155.52 Mbits/s。(2) “同步光网络”（SONET）是一种通过在光纤上使用同步传输格式，提供管理、复用和接入各种形式数字业务手段的网络。该格式为“SDH”的北美版本，也使用同步传送模块（STM）。但其采用同步传送信号（STS）作为基本传送模块，第一级速率为51.81 Mbits/s。SONET标准正在并入“SDH”标准。
text.en: Related Definitions: (1) “Synchronous digital hierarchy” (SDH) is a digital hierarchy providing a means to manage, multiplex, and access various forms of digital traffic using a synchronous transmission format on different types of media. The format is based on the Synchronous Transport Module (STM) that is defined by CCITT Recommendation G.703, G.707, G.708, G.709 and others yet to be published. The first level rate of ‘SDH’ is 155.52 Mbits/s. (2) ‘Synchronous optical network’ (SONET) is a network providing a means to manage, multiplex and access various forms of digital traffic using a synchronous transmission format on fiber optics. The format is the North America version of ‘SDH’ and also uses the Synchronous Transport Module (STM). However, it uses the Synchronous Transport Signal (STS) as the basic transport module with a first level rate of 51.81 Mbits/s. The SONET standards are being integrated into those of ‘SDH’.

text.en: a.1. “Technology” for the processing and application of coatings to optical fiber “specially designed” to make it suitable for underwater use;

text.zh: a.2. 用于“开发”采用“同步数字体系”（“SDH”）或“同步光网络”（“SONET”）技术的设备的“技术”。
text.en: a.2. “Technology” for the “development” of equipment employing ‘Synchronous Digital Hierarchy’ (‘SDH’) or ‘Synchronous Optical Network’ (‘SONET’) techniques.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) ECCN 5A002.a管制提供“信息安全”所需手段或功能的“部件”。所有此类“部件”均推定为“专门设计”，并受5A002.a管制。(2) 5A002.d或.e所述且“受ITAR管辖”的系统、设备和部件的管制，见USML第XI类（包括XI(b)）及第XIII(b)类（包括XIII(b)(2)）（见22 CFR第120至130部分）。(3) 含有或使用解密的“卫星导航系统”接收设备见7A005；相关解密“软件”和“技术”见7D005和7E001。(4) 应注意，物项可能受CCL其他条目管制；不受ECCN 5A002.a.4管制的物项示例如下：(a) 一辆汽车，其唯一采用“所述安全算法”的“数据保密密码功能”由车内安装、符合第5类第2部分注3条件的移动电话执行。在此情形下，安全电话通信支持汽车的一项非主要功能，但该移动电话（设备）作为独立物项，因《密码说明》（注3）将其排除而不受ECCN 5A002管制（见ECCN 5A992.c）。(b) 一辆嵌入符合第5类第2部分注3条件的网页浏览器的健身自行车，其唯一受管制密码功能由网页浏览器执行。在此情形下，安全网页浏览支持健身自行车的一项非主要功能，但网页浏览器（“软件”）作为独立物项，因《密码说明》（注3）将其排除而不受ECCN 5D002管制（见ECCN 5D992.c）。(5) 按EAR第740.17(b)条完成分类或自行分类后，符合资格要求的大众市场加密商品解除“EI”和“NS”管制。这些商品归为5A992.c。(6) 另见ECCN 3A090和4A090。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) ECCN 5A002.a controls “components” providing the means or functions necessary for “information security.” All such “components” are presumptively “specially designed” and controlled by 5A002.a. (2) See USML Categories XI (including XI(b)) and XIII(b) (including XIII(b)(2)) for controls on systems, equipment, and components described in 5A002.d or .e that are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130). (3) For “satellite navigation system” receiving equipment containing or employing decryption see 7A005, and for related decryption “software” and “technology” see 7D005 and 7E001. (4) Noting that items may be controlled elsewhere on the CCL, examples of items not controlled by ECCN 5A002.a.4 include the following: (a) An automobile where the only 'cryptography for data confidentiality' having a 'described security algorithm' is performed by a Category 5—Part 2 Note 3 eligible mobile telephone that is built into the car. In this case, secure phone communications support a non-primary function of the automobile but the mobile telephone (equipment), as a standalone item, is not controlled by ECCN 5A002 because it is excluded by the Cryptography Note (Note 3) (See ECCN 5A992.c). (b) An exercise bike with an embedded Category 5—Part 2 Note 3 eligible web browser, where the only controlled cryptography is performed by the web browser. In this case, secure web browsing supports a non-primary function of the exercise bike but the web browser (“software”), as a standalone item, is not controlled by ECCN 5D002 because it is excluded by the Cryptography Note (Note 3) (See ECCN 5D992.c). (5) After classification or self-classification in accordance with § 740.17(b) of the EAR, mass market encryption commodities that meet eligibility requirements are released from “EI” and “NS” controls. These commodities are designated 5A992.c. (6) See also ECCNs 3A090 and 4A090.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就5A002.a而言，“数据保密密码功能”是指采用数字技术，且执行下列任一功能以外的任何密码功能的“密码技术”：
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 5A002.a, 'cryptography for data confidentiality' means “cryptography” that employs digital techniques and performs any cryptographic function other than any of the following:

text.zh: 1.a. “身份鉴别”；
text.en: 1.a. “Authentication;”

text.zh: 1.b. 数字签名；
text.en: 1.b. Digital signature;

text.zh: 1.c. 数据完整性；
text.en: 1.c. Data integrity;

text.zh: 1.d. 不可否认性；
text.en: 1.d. Non-repudiation;

text.zh: 1.e. 数字版权管理，包括执行受复制保护的“软件”；
text.en: 1.e. Digital rights management, including the execution of copy-protected “software;”

text.zh: 1.f. 支持娱乐、大众商业广播或医疗记录管理的加密或解密；或
text.en: 1.f. Encryption or decryption in support of entertainment, mass commercial broadcasts or medical records management; or

text.zh: 1.g. 支持本技术说明第1段1.a至1.f款所述任一功能的密钥管理。
text.en: 1.g. Key management in support of any function described in paragraphs 1.a to 1.f of this Technical Note paragraph 1.

text.zh: 2. 就5A002.a而言，“所述安全算法”指下列任一算法：
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 5A002.a, 'described security algorithm' means any of the following:

text.zh: 2.a. 密钥长度超过56位（不包括奇偶校验位）的“对称算法”；
text.en: 2.a. A “symmetric algorithm” employing a key length in excess of 56 bits, not including parity bits;

text.zh: 2.b. 算法安全性基于下列任一问题的“非对称算法”：
text.en: 2.b. An “asymmetric algorithm” where the security of the algorithm is based on any of the following:

text.zh: 2.b.1. 对超过512位的整数进行因数分解（例如RSA）；
text.en: 2.b.1. Factorization of integers in excess of 512 bits (e.g., RSA);

text.zh: 2.b.2. 在规模大于512位的有限域乘法群中计算离散对数（例如Z/pZ上的Diffie-Hellman）；或
text.en: 2.b.2. Computation of discrete logarithms in a multiplicative group of a finite field of size greater than 512 bits (e.g., Diffie-Hellman over Z/pZ); or

text.zh: 2.b.3. 在本技术说明2.b.2款所述以外的群中计算超过112位的离散对数（例如椭圆曲线上的Diffie-Hellman）；或
text.en: 2.b.3. Discrete logarithms in a group other than mentioned in paragraph 2.b.2 of this Technical Note in excess of 112 bits (e.g., Diffie-Hellman over an elliptic curve); or

text.zh: 2.c. 算法安全性基于下列任一问题的“非对称算法”：
text.en: 2.c. An “asymmetric algorithm” where the security of the algorithm is based on any of the following:

text.zh: 2.c.1. 与格有关的最短向量或最近向量问题（例如NewHope、Frodo、NTRUEncrypt、Kyber、Titanium）；
text.en: 2.c.1. Shortest vector or closest vector problems associated with lattices (e.g., NewHope, Frodo, NTRUEncrypt, Kyber, Titanium);

text.zh: 2.c.2. 寻找超奇异椭圆曲线之间的同源映射（例如超奇异同源密钥封装）；或
text.en: 2.c.2. Finding isogenies between Supersingular elliptic curves (e.g., Supersingular Isogeny Key Encapsulation); or

text.zh: 2.c.3. 随机码解码（例如McEliece、Niederreiter）。
text.en: 2.c.3. Decoding random codes (e.g., McEliece, Niederreiter).

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 技术说明2.c所述算法也可称为后量子、量子安全或抗量子算法。
text.en: An algorithm described by Technical Note 2.c. may be referred to as being post-quantum, quantum-safe or quantum-resistant.
Note 1:

text.zh: 必须能够获取并应请求提供物项详细资料，以确定以下任一事项：
text.en: Details of items must be accessible and provided upon request, in order to establish any of the following:

text.zh: a. 该物项是否符合5A002.a.1至a.4的标准；或
text.en: a. Whether the item meets the criteria of 5A002.a.1 to a.4; or

text.zh: b. 5A002.a所列数据保密密码能力能否在未经“密码激活”的情况下使用。
text.en: b. Whether the cryptographic capability for data confidentiality specified by 5A002.a is usable without “cryptographic activation.”
Note 2:

text.zh: 5A002.a不管制下列任何物项，或为其专门设计的“信息安全”部件：
text.en: 5A002.a does not control any of the following items, or specially designed “information security” components therefor:

text.zh: a. 下列智能卡和智能卡“读写器”：
text.en: a. Smart cards and smart card 'readers/writers' as follows:

text.zh: a.1. 满足下列任一条件的智能卡或可电子读取的个人证件（例如令牌币、电子护照）：
text.en: a.1. A smart card or an electronically readable personal document (e.g., token coin, e-passport) that meets any of the following:

text.zh: a.1.a. 密码能力同时满足以下全部条件：
text.en: a.1.a. The cryptographic capability meets all of the following:

text.zh: a.1.a.1. 仅限用于下列任一设备或系统：
text.en: a.1.a.1. It is restricted for use in any of the following:

text.zh: a.1.a.1.a. 5A002.a.1至a.4未描述的设备或系统；
text.en: a.1.a.1.a. Equipment or systems, not described by 5A002.a.1 to a.4;

text.zh: a.1.a.1.b. 不使用采用“所述安全算法”的“数据保密密码功能”的设备或系统；或
text.en: a.1.a.1.b. Equipment or systems, not using 'cryptography for data confidentiality' having a 'described security algorithm'; or

text.zh: a.1.a.1.c. 本注b至f项排除于5A002.a之外的设备或系统；以及
text.en: a.1.a.1.c. Equipment or systems, excluded from 5A002.a by entries b. to f. of this Note; and

text.zh: a.1.a.2. 不能重新编程用于任何其他用途；或
text.en: a.1.a.2. It cannot be reprogrammed for any other use; or

text.zh: a.1.b. 同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: a.1.b. Having all of the following:

text.zh: a.1.b.1. 专门设计且仅限于保护内部存储的“个人数据”；
text.en: a.1.b.1. It is specially designed and limited to allow protection of 'personal data' stored within;

text.zh: a.1.b.2. 已经或只能为公共或商业交易或个人身份识别进行个性化设置；以及
text.en: a.1.b.2. Has been, or can only be, personalized for public or commercial transactions or individual identification; and

text.zh: a.1.b.3. 用户无法访问其密码能力；
text.en: a.1.b.3. Where the cryptographic capability is not user-accessible;

text.zh: 注2的a.1.b.1款技术说明：
text.en: Technical Note to paragraph a.1.b.1 of Note 2:

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph a.1.b.1 of Note 2:

text.zh: 就5A002.a注2的a.1.b.1款而言，“个人数据”包括与特定个人或实体有关的任何数据，例如储存的金额及“身份鉴别”所需的数据。
text.en: For the purposes of 5A002.a Note 2.-a.1.b.1, 'personal data' includes any data specific to a particular person or entity, such as the amount of money stored and data necessary for “authentication.”

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph a.1.b.1 of Note 2:

text.zh: a.2. 为本注a.1款所列物项专门设计或改装、且仅限于这些物项的“读写器”；
text.en: a.2. 'Readers/writers' specially designed or modified, and limited, for items specified by paragraph a.1 of this Note;

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph a.1.b.1 of Note 2:

text.zh: 注2的a.2款技术说明：
text.en: Technical Note to paragraph a.2 of Note 2:

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph a.2 of Note 2:

text.zh: 就5A002.a注2的a.2款而言，“读写器”包括通过网络与智能卡或可电子读取文件通信的设备。
text.en: 'For the purposes of 5A002.a Note 2.a.2, 'readers/writers' include equipment that communicates with smart cards or electronically readable documents through a network.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph a.2 of Note 2:

text.zh: b. 专门设计且仅限于银行业务或“货币交易”的密码设备；
text.en: b. Cryptographic equipment specially designed and limited for banking use or 'money transactions';

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph a.2 of Note 2:

text.zh: 注2的b款技术说明：
text.en: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: 就5A002.a注2.b而言，5A002注2的b款中的“货币交易”包括费用收取和结算或信用功能。
text.en: For the purposes of 5A002.a Note 2.b, 'money transactions' in 5A002 Note 2 paragraph b. includes the collection and settlement of fares or credit functions.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: c. 民用便携式或移动无线电话（例如用于商业民用蜂窝无线电通信系统），其不能直接向另一无线电话或设备（无线接入网络〔RAN〕设备除外）传输加密数据，也不能通过RAN设备（例如无线网络控制器〔RNC〕或基站控制器〔BSC〕）传送加密数据；
text.en: c. Portable or mobile radiotelephones for civil use (e.g., for use with commercial civil cellular radio communication systems) that are not capable of transmitting encrypted data directly to another radiotelephone or equipment (other than Radio Access Network (RAN) equipment), nor of passing encrypted data through RAN equipment (e.g., Radio Network Controller (RNC) or Base Station Controller (BSC));

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: d. 不具备端到端加密能力，且按制造商规格，在不放大情况下无线运行的最大有效距离（即终端与家庭基站之间单次、无中继跳传）小于400米的无绳电话设备；
text.en: d. Cordless telephone equipment not capable of end-to-end encryption where the maximum effective range of unboosted cordless operation (i.e., a single, unrelayed hop between terminal and home base station) is less than 400 meters according to the manufacturer's specifications;

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: e. 仅实施已公开或商用密码标准（反盗版功能可不公开），并符合《密码说明》（第5类第2部分注3）a.2至a.4款规定的民用便携式或移动无线电话及类似客户端无线设备；上述设备已针对特定民用行业应用定制，且增加的功能不影响原始未定制设备的密码功能；
text.en: e. Portable or mobile radiotelephones and similar client wireless devices for civil use, that implement only published or commercial cryptographic standards (except for anti-piracy functions, which may be non-published) and also meet the provisions of paragraphs a.2 to a.4 of the Cryptography Note (Note 3 in Category 5—Part 2), that have been customized for a specific civil industry application with features that do not affect the cryptographic functionality of these original non-customized devices;

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: f. “信息安全”功能仅限于实施已公开或商用密码标准的无线“个人区域网”功能的物项；
text.en: f. Items, where the “information security” functionality is limited to wireless “personal area network ” functionality implementing only published or commercial cryptographic standards;

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: g. 为民用设计、同时符合《密码说明》（第5类第2部分注3）a.2至a.4款规定、射频输出功率限于0.1 W（20 dBm）或以下且支持不超过16个并发用户的移动电信无线接入网络（RAN）设备；
text.en: g. Mobile telecommunications Radio Access Network (RAN) equipment designed for civil use, which also meet the provisions of paragraphs a.2 to a.4 of the Cryptography Note (Note 3 in Category 5—Part 2), having an RF output power limited to 0.1W (20 dBm) or less, and supporting 16 or fewer concurrent users;

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: h. “信息安全”功能仅限于实施已公开或商用密码标准的“操作、管理或维护”（“OAM”）任务的路由器、交换机、网关或中继器；
text.en: h. Routers, switches, gateways or relays, where the “information security” functionality is limited to the tasks of “Operations, Administration or Maintenance” (“OAM”) implementing only published or commercial cryptographic standards;

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: i. “信息安全”功能同时满足以下全部条件的通用计算设备或服务器：
text.en: i. General purpose computing equipment or servers, where the “information security” functionality meets all of the following:

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: i.1. 仅使用已公开或商用密码标准；以及
text.en: i.1. Uses only published or commercial cryptographic standards; and

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: i.2. 属于以下任一种情形：
text.en: i.2. Is any of the following:

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: i.2.a. 为符合第5类第2部分注3规定的CPU的组成部分；
text.en: i.2.a. Integral to a CPU that meets the provisions of Note 3 in Category 5—Part 2;

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: i.2.b. 为5D002未列明的操作系统的组成部分；或
text.en: i.2.b. Integral to an operating system that is not specified by 5D002; or

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: i.2.c. 仅限于设备的“OAM”；或
text.en: i.2.c. Limited to “OAM” of the equipment; or

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: j. 为“联网民用行业应用”专门设计，且同时满足以下全部条件的物项：
text.en: j. Items specially designed for a 'connected civil industry application', meeting all of the following:

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: j.1. 属于下列任一种：
text.en: j.1. Being any of the following:

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: j.1.a. 满足下列任一条件的具有联网能力的终端设备：
text.en: j.1.a. A network-capable endpoint device meeting any of the following:

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: j.1.a.1. “信息安全”功能仅限于保护“非任意数据”或执行“操作、管理或维护”（“OAM”）任务；或
text.en: j.1.a.1. The “information security” functionality is limited to securing 'non-arbitrary data' or the tasks of “Operations, Administration or Maintenance” (“OAM”); or

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: j.1.a.2. 该设备仅限于特定“联网民用行业应用”；或
text.en: j.1.a.2. The device is limited to a specific 'connected civil industry application'; or

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: j.1.b. 同时满足以下全部条件的联网设备：
text.en: j.1.b. Networking equipment meeting all of the following:

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: j.1.b.1. 为与上述j.1.a款所列设备通信而专门设计；以及
text.en: j.1.b.1. Being specially designed to communicate with the devices specified by paragraph j.1.a. above; and

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: j.1.b.2. “信息安全”功能仅限于支持上述j.1.a款所列设备的“联网民用行业应用”，或执行该联网设备或本注j款所列其他物项的“OAM”任务；以及
text.en: j.1.b.2. The “information security” functionality is limited to supporting the 'connected civil industry application' of devices specified by paragraph j.1.a. above, or the tasks of “OAM” of this networking equipment or of other items specified by paragraph j. of this Note; and

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: j.2. “信息安全”功能仅实施已公开或商用密码标准，且用户不能轻易改变密码功能。
text.en: j.2. Where the “information security” functionality implements only published or commercial cryptographic standards, and the cryptographic functionality cannot easily be changed by the user.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就5A002.a注2.j而言，“联网民用行业应用”是指“信息安全”、数字通信、通用联网或计算以外的联网消费或民用行业应用。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 5A002.a Note 2.j, 'connected civil industry application' means a network-connected consumer or civil industry application other than “information security”, digital communication, general purpose networking or computing.

text.zh: 2. 就5A002.a注2.j.1.a.1而言，“非任意数据”是与系统稳定性、性能或物理测量直接相关的传感器或计量数据（例如温度、压力、流量、质量、体积、电压、物理位置等），且设备用户不能改变此类数据。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 5A002.a Note 2.j.1.a.1, 'non-arbitrary data' means sensor or metering data directly related to the stability, performance or physical measurement of a system (e.g., temperature, pressure, flow rate, mass, volume, voltage, physical location, etc.), that cannot be changed by the user of the device.

text.zh: b. 属于“密码激活令牌”；
text.en: b. Being a 'cryptographic activation token';

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就5A002.b而言，“密码激活令牌”是为下列任一用途设计或改装的物项：
text.en: For the purposes of 5A002.b, a 'cryptographic activation token' is an item designed or modified for any of the following:

text.zh: 1. 通过“密码激活”，将第5类第2部分未列明的物项转换为5A002.a或5D002.c.1所列、且未由《密码说明》（第5类第2部分注3）解除管制的物项；或
text.en: 1. Converting, by means of “cryptographic activation”, an item not specified by Category 5—Part 2 into an item specified by 5A002.a or 5D002.c.1, and not released by the Cryptography Note (Note 3 in Category 5—Part 2); or

text.zh: 2. 通过“密码激活”，使第5类第2部分已列明的物项启用5A002.a所列的额外功能；
text.en: 2. Enabling by means of “cryptographic activation”, additional functionality specified by 5A002.a of an item already specified by Category 5—Part 2;

text.zh: c. 为使用或执行“量子密码”而设计或改装；
text.en: c. Designed or modified to use or perform “quantum cryptography”;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就5A002.c而言，“量子密码”也称量子密钥分发（QKD）。
text.en: For the purposes of 5A002.c,”quantum cryptography” is also known as Quantum Key Distribution (QKD).

text.zh: d. 为使用密码技术，给采用超宽带调制技术且具有下列任一特性的系统生成信道化码、扰码或网络识别码而设计或改装：
text.en: d. Designed or modified to use cryptographic techniques to generate channelizing codes, scrambling codes or network identification codes, for systems using ultra-wideband modulation techniques and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1. 带宽超过500 MHz；或
text.en: d.1. A bandwidth exceeding 500 MHz; or

text.zh: d.2. “相对带宽”为20%或以上；
text.en: d.2. A “fractional bandwidth” of 20% or more;

text.zh: e. 为使用密码技术，为5A002.d未列明的“扩频”系统生成扩频码（包括“跳频”系统的跳频码）而设计或改装。
text.en: e. Designed or modified to use cryptographic techniques to generate the spreading code for “spread spectrum” systems, not specified by 5A002.d, including the hopping code for “frequency hopping” systems.

text.zh: f. 至y. ［保留］
text.en: f. through y. [Reserved]

text.zh: z. 下列其他商品：
text.en: z. Other commodities, as follows:

text.zh: z.1.a. 5A002.a所述且同时达到或超过3A090.a或4A090.a性能参数的商品；
text.en: z.1.a. Commodities that are described in 5A002.a and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in 3A090.a or 4A090.a;

text.zh: z.1.b. 5A002.a所述且同时达到或超过3A090.b或4A090.b性能参数的商品；
text.en: z.1.b Commodities that are described in 5A002.a and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in 3A090.b or 4A090.b;

text.zh: z.2.a. 5A002.b所述且同时达到或超过3A090.a或4A090.a性能参数的商品；
text.en: z.2.a Commodities that are described in 5A002.b and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in 3A090.a or 4A090.a;

text.zh: z.2.b. 5A002.b所述且同时达到或超过3A090.b或4A090.b性能参数的商品；
text.en: z.2.b Commodities that are described in 5A002.b and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in 3A090.b or 4A090.b;

text.zh: z.3.a. 5A002.c所述且同时达到或超过3A090.a或4A090.a性能参数的商品；
text.en: z.3.a Commodities that are described in 5A002.c and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in 3A090.a or 4A090.a;

text.zh: z.3.b. 5A002.c所述且同时达到或超过3A090.b或4A090.b性能参数的商品；
text.en: z.3.b Commodities that are described in 5A002.c and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in 3A090.b or 4A090.b;

text.zh: z.4.a. 5A002.d所述且同时达到或超过3A090.a或4A090.a性能参数的商品；
text.en: z.4.a Commodities that are described in 5A002.d and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in 3A090.a or 4A090.a;

text.zh: z.4.b. 5A002.d所述且同时达到或超过3A090.b或4A090.b性能参数的商品；
text.en: z.4.b Commodities that are described in 5A002.d and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in 3A090.b or 4A090.b;

text.zh: z.5.a. 5A002.e所述且同时达到或超过3A090.a或4A090.a性能参数的商品；或
text.en: z.5.a Commodities that are described in 5A002.e and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in 3A090.a or 4A090.a; or

text.zh: z.5.b. 5A002.e所述且同时达到或超过3A090.b或4A090.b性能参数的商品。
text.en: z.5.b Commodities that are described in 5A002.e and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in 3A090.b or 4A090.b.

text.zh: a. 为执行“密码分析功能”而设计或改装。
text.en: a. Designed or modified to perform 'cryptanalytic functions.'

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5A004.a包括为通过逆向工程执行“密码分析功能”而设计或改装的系统或设备。
text.en: 5A004.a includes systems or equipment, designed or modified to perform 'cryptanalytic functions' by means of reverse engineering.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就5A004.a而言，“密码分析功能”是为破解密码机制，以获取保密变量或敏感数据（包括明文、密码或密码密钥）而设计的功能。
text.en: For the purposes of 5A004.a, 'cryptanalytic functions' are functions designed to defeat cryptographic mechanisms in order to derive confidential variables or sensitive data, including clear text, passwords or cryptographic keys.

text.zh: b. ECCN 4A005或5A004.a未列明、为执行以下全部操作而设计的物项：
text.en: b. Items, not specified by ECCNs 4A005 or 5A004.a, designed to perform all of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 从计算或通信设备“提取原始数据”；以及
text.en: b.1. 'Extract raw data' from a computing or communications device; and

text.zh: b.2. 绕过该设备的“身份鉴别”或授权控制，以执行5A004.b.1所述功能。
text.en: b.2. Circumvent “authentication” or authorization controls of the device, in order to perform the function described in 5A004.b.1.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就5A004.b.1而言，从计算或通信设备“提取原始数据”是指从该设备的存储介质（例如RAM、闪存或硬盘）读取二进制数据，而不经该设备操作系统或文件系统解析。
text.en: For the purposes of 5A004.b.1, 'extract raw data' from a computing or communications device means to retrieve binary data from a storage medium, e.g., RAM, flash or hard disk, of the device without interpretation by the device's operating system or filesystem.
Note 1:

text.zh: 5A004.b不适用于为“开发”或“生产”计算或通信设备而专门设计的系统或设备。
text.en: 5A004.b does not apply to systems or equipment specially designed for the “development” or “production” of a computing or communications device.
Note 2:

text.zh: 5A004.b不包括：
text.en: 5A004.b does not include:

text.zh: a. 调试器、虚拟机监控器；
text.en: a. Debuggers, hypervisors;

text.zh: b. 仅限于逻辑数据提取的物项；
text.en: b. Items limited to logical data extraction;

text.zh: c. 使用芯片拆取或JTAG的数据提取物项；或
text.en: c. Data extraction items using chip-off or JTAG; or

text.zh: d. 专门设计且仅限于越狱或获取root权限的物项。
text.en: d. Items specially designed and limited to jail-breaking or rooting.

text.zh: c. 至y. ［保留］
text.en: c. through y. [Reserved]

text.en: z.1.b Commodities that are described in 5A004.a and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in 3A090.b or 4A090.b;

text.zh: z.2.b. 5A004.b所述且同时达到或超过3A090.b或4A090.b性能参数的商品。
text.en: z.2.b Commodities that are described in 5A004.b and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in 3A090.b or 4A090.b.

text.zh: 许可要求注：
text.en: License Requirements Notes:

text.zh: (1) 处理速度为5 GFLOPS或以上且算术逻辑单元访问宽度为32位或以上的微处理器（包括含有“信息安全”功能的微处理器），以及用于“生产”或“开发”此类微处理器的相关“软件”和“技术”的额外许可要求，见EAR第744.17条。
text.en: (1) See § 744.17 of the EAR for additional license requirements for microprocessors having a processing speed of 5 GFLOPS or more and an arithmetic logic unit with an access width of 32 bit or more, including those incorporating “information security” functionality, and associated “software” and “technology” for the “production” or “development” of such microprocessors.

text.zh: (2) 当某人实施或提供的技术协助纳入或以其他方式利用在美国获得或为美国原产的“技术”时，即发生该“技术”的释放。若提供此类技术协助的意图是帮助“开发”或“生产”将根据ECCN 5A002、5A004或5D002因“EI”理由受到管制的加密商品或软件，即使拟实施的基础加密算法属于公共领域或非美国原产，也可能需要EAR项下授权。
text.en: (2) When a person performs or provides technical assistance that incorporates, or otherwise draws upon, “technology” that was either obtained in the United States or is of U.S.-origin, then a release of the “technology” takes place. Such technical assistance, when rendered with the intent to aid in the “development” or “production” of encryption commodities or software that would be controlled for “EI” reasons under ECCN 5A002, 5A004 or 5D002, may require authorization under the EAR even if the underlying encryption algorithm to be implemented is from the public domain or is not of U.S.-origin.

text.en: STA: License Exception STA may not be used to ship commodities in 6A001.a.1.b, 6A001.a.1.e or 6A001.a.2 (except .a.2.a.4) to any of the destinations listed in Country Group A:6 (See Supplement No.1 to part 740 of the EAR).

text.zh: 相关定义：不适用
text.en: Related Definitions: N/A

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 下列海洋声学系统、设备以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
text.en: a. Marine acoustic systems, equipment and “specially designed” “components” therefor, as follows:

text.zh: a.1. 下列主动式（发射或收发）系统、设备以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
text.en: a.1. Active (transmitting or transmitting-and-receiving) systems, equipment and “specially designed” “components” therefor, as follows:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A001.a.1不管制下列设备：
text.en: 6A001.a.1 does not control equipment as follows:

text.zh: a. 在装置正下方垂直工作，不具有超过±20°的扫描功能，且仅限于测量水深、水下或埋藏物体距离或探鱼的测深仪；
text.en: a. Depth sounders operating vertically below the apparatus, not including a scanning function exceeding ± 20°, and limited to measuring the depth of water, the distance of submerged or buried objects or fish finding;

text.zh: b. 下列声信标：
text.en: b. Acoustic beacons, as follows:

text.zh: 1. 声学应急信标；
text.en: 1. Acoustic emergency beacons;

text.zh: 2. 为重新定位或返回某水下位置而“专门设计”的声脉冲发生器。
text.en: 2. Pingers “specially designed” for relocating or returning to an underwater position.

text.zh: a.1.a. 下列海底声学测绘设备：
text.en: a.1.a. Acoustic seabed survey equipment as follows:

text.zh: a.1.a.1. 为海底地形测绘设计，且同时具有以下全部特性的水面船舶测绘设备：
text.en: a.1.a.1. Surface vessel survey equipment designed for sea bed topographic mapping and having all of the following:

text.zh: a.1.a.1.a. 设计为在偏离垂直方向超过20°的角度进行测量；
text.en: a.1.a.1.a. Designed to take measurements at an angle exceeding 20° from the vertical;

text.zh: a.1.a.1.b. 设计为测量深度超过600 m的海底地形；
text.en: a.1.a.1.b. Designed to measure seabed topography at seabed depths exceeding 600 m;

text.zh: a.1.a.1.c. “测深分辨率”小于2；以及
text.en: a.1.a.1.c.'Sounding resolution' less than 2; and

text.zh: a.1.a.1.d. 通过补偿以下全部因素来“提高”深度“准确度”：
text.en: a.1.a.1.d. 'Enhancement' of the depth “accuracy” through compensation for all the following:

text.zh: a.1.a.1.d.1. 声传感器运动；
text.en: a.1.a.1.d.1. Motion of the acoustic sensor;

text.zh: a.1.a.1.d.2. 从传感器至海底再返回的水中传播；以及
text.en: a.1.a.1.d.2. In-water propagation from sensor to the seabed and back; and

text.zh: a.1.a.1.d.3. 传感器处的声速；
text.en: a.1.a.1.d.3. Sound speed at the sensor;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就6A001.a.1.a.1.c而言，“测深分辨率”为条带宽度（度）除以每条带最大测深点数。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 6A001.a.1.a.1.c, 'sounding resolution' is the swath width (degrees) divided by the maximum number of soundings per swath.

text.zh: 2. 就6A001.a.1.a而言，“提高”包括通过外部手段进行补偿的能力。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 6A001.a.1.a, 'enhancement' includes the ability to compensate by external means.

text.zh: a.1.a.2. 为海底地形测绘设计，且具有下列任一特性的水下测绘设备：
text.en: a.1.a.2. Underwater survey equipment designed for seabed topographic mapping and having any of the following:

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A001.a.1.a.2而言，声传感器额定压力决定额定深度。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A001.a.1.a.2, the acoustic sensor pressure rating determines the depth rating.

text.zh: a.1.a.2.a. 同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: a.1.a.2.a. Having all of the following:

text.zh: a.1.a.2.a.1. 为在超过300 m的深度运行而设计或改装；以及
text.en: a.1.a.2.a.1. Designed or modified to operate at depths exceeding 300 m; and

text.zh: a.1.a.2.a.2. “测深速率”大于3,800 m/s；或
text.en: a.1.a.2.a.2. 'Sounding rate' greater than 3,800 m/s; or

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A001.a.1.a.2.a.2而言，“测深速率”为传感器可运行的最大速度（m/s）与假设100%覆盖时每条带最大测深点数的乘积。对于在两个方向产生测深结果的系统（3D声纳），应采用两个方向中较大的“测深速率”。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A001.a.1.a.2.a.2, 'sounding rate' is the product of the maximum speed (m/s) at which the sensor can operate and the maximum number of soundings per swath assuming 100% coverage. For systems that produce soundings in two directions (3D sonars), the maximum of the 'sounding rate' in either direction should be used.

text.zh: a.1.a.2.b. 6A001.a.1.a.2.a未列明、且同时具有以下全部特性的测绘设备：
text.en: a.1.a.2.b. Survey equipment, not specified by 6A001.a.1.a.2.a, having all of the following:

text.zh: a.1.a.2.b.1. 为在超过100 m的深度运行而设计或改装；
text.en: a.1.a.2.b.1. Designed or modified to operate at depths exceeding 100 m;

text.zh: a.1.a.2.b.2. 设计为在偏离垂直方向超过20°的角度进行测量；
text.en: a.1.a.2.b.2. Designed to take measurements at an angle exceeding 20° from the vertical;

text.zh: a.1.a.2.b.3. 具有下列任一特性：
text.en: a.1.a.2.b.3. Having any of the following:

text.zh: a.1.a.2.b.3.a. 工作频率低于350 kHz；或
text.en: a.1.a.2.b.3.a. Operating frequency below 350 kHz; or

text.zh: a.1.a.2.b.3.b. 设计为测量距声传感器超过200 m范围的海底地形；以及
text.en: a.1.a.2.b.3.b. Designed to measure seabed topography at a range exceeding 200 m from the acoustic sensor; and

text.zh: a.1.a.2.b.4. 通过补偿以下全部因素来“提高”深度“准确度”：
text.en: a.1.a.2.b.4. 'Enhancement' of the depth “accuracy” through compensation of all of the following:

text.zh: a.1.a.2.b.4.a. 声传感器运动；
text.en: a.1.a.2.b.4.a. Motion of the acoustic sensor;

text.zh: a.1.a.2.b.4.b. 从传感器至海底再返回的水中传播；以及
text.en: a.1.a.2.b.4.b. In-water propagation from sensor to the seabed and back; and

text.zh: a.1.a.2.b.4.c. 传感器处的声速。
text.en: a.1.a.2.b.4.c. Sound speed at the sensor.

text.zh: a.1.a.3. 为海底成像设计且同时具有以下全部特性的侧扫声纳（SSS）或合成孔径声纳（SAS），以及为其“专门设计”的发射和接收声阵列：
text.en: a.1.a.3. Side Scan Sonar (SSS) or Synthetic Aperture Sonar (SAS), designed for seabed imaging and having all of the following, and “specially designed” transmitting and receiving acoustic arrays therefor:

text.zh: a.1.a.3.a. 为在超过500 m的深度运行而设计或改装；以及
text.en: a.1.a.3.a. Designed or modified to operate at depths exceeding 500 m; and

text.zh: a.1.a.3.b. 在可实现小于15 cm“沿航迹分辨率”的最大作用距离工作时，“面积覆盖速率”大于570 m^{2}/s；以及
text.en: a.1.a.3.b. An 'area coverage rate' of greater than 570 m^{2}/s while operating at the maximum range that it can operate with an 'along track resolution' of less than 15 cm; and

text.zh: a.1.a.3.c. “横航迹分辨率”小于15 cm；
text.en: a.1.a.3.c. An 'across track resolution' of less than 15 cm;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:
For the purposes of 6A001.a.1.a.3:

text.zh: 1. “面积覆盖速率”（m_{2}/s）为声纳作用距离（m）与传感器在该距离可运行的最大速度（m/s）乘积的两倍。
text.en: 1. 'Area coverage rate' (m_{2}/s) is twice the product of the sonar range (m) and the maximum speed (m/s) at which the sensor can operate at that range.

text.zh: 2. 仅就SSS而言，“沿航迹分辨率”（cm）为方位（水平）波束宽度（度）、声纳作用距离（m）与0.873的乘积。
text.en: 2. 'Along track resolution' (cm), for SSS only, is the product of azimuth (horizontal) beamwidth (degrees) and sonar range (m) and 0.873.

text.zh: 3. “横航迹分辨率”（cm）为75除以信号带宽（kHz）。
text.en: 3. 'Across track resolution' (cm) is 75 divided by the signal bandwidth (kHz).

text.zh: a.1.b. 为目标探测或定位设计，且具有下列任一特性的系统或发射和接收阵列：
text.en: a.1.b Systems or transmitting and receiving arrays, designed for object detection or location, having any of the following:

text.zh: a.1.b.1. 发射频率低于10 kHz；
text.en: a.1.b.1. A transmitting frequency below 10 kHz;

text.zh: a.1.b.2. 工作频率在10 kHz至24 kHz（含端点）频段内的设备，声压级超过224 dB（参考值为1 m处1 µPa）；
text.en: a.1.b.2. Sound pressure level exceeding 224dB (reference 1 µPa at 1 m) for equipment with an operating frequency in the band from 10 kHz to 24 kHz inclusive;

text.zh: a.1.b.3. 工作频率在24 kHz与30 kHz之间频段内的设备，声压级超过235 dB（参考值为1 m处1 µPa）；
text.en: a.1.b.3. Sound pressure level exceeding 235 dB (reference 1 µPa at 1 m) for equipment with an operating frequency in the band between 24 kHz and 30 kHz;

text.zh: a.1.b.4. 在任一轴上形成小于1°的波束，且工作频率低于100 kHz；
text.en: a.1.b.4. Forming beams of less than 1° on any axis and having an operating frequency of less than 100 kHz;

text.zh: a.1.b.5. 设计为无模糊显示距离超过5,120 m；或
text.en: a.1.b.5. Designed to operate with an unambiguous display range exceeding 5,120 m; or

text.zh: a.1.b.6. 设计为在超过1,000 m深度正常运行时承受压力，且其换能器具有下列任一特性：
text.en: a.1.b.6. Designed to withstand pressure during normal operation at depths exceeding 1,000 m and having transducers with any of the following:

text.zh: a.1.b.6.a. 压力动态补偿；或
text.en: a.1.b.6.a. Dynamic compensation for pressure; or

text.zh: a.1.b.6.b. 采用锆钛酸铅以外的材料作为换能元件；
text.en: a.1.b.6.b. Incorporating other than lead zirconate titanate as the transduction element;

text.zh: a.1.c. 采用压电、磁致伸缩、电致伸缩、电动或液压元件单独或按设计组合运行，且具有下列任一特性的声发射器（包括换能器）：
text.en: a.1.c. Acoustic projectors, including transducers, incorporating piezoelectric, magnetostrictive, electrostrictive, electrodynamic or hydraulic elements operating individually or in a designed combination and having any of the following:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Notes:

text.zh: 1. 为其他设备“专门设计”的声发射器（包括换能器）的管制状态，由该其他设备的管制状态决定。
text.en: 1. The control status of acoustic projectors, including transducers, “specially designed” for other equipment is determined by the control status of the other equipment.

text.zh: 2. 6A001.a.1.c不管制仅垂直定向发声的电子声源，或机械声源（例如气枪或蒸汽冲击枪），或化学声源（例如爆炸物）。
text.en: 2. 6A001.a.1.c does not control electronic sources that direct the sound vertically only, or mechanical (e.g., air gun or vapor-shock gun) or chemical (e.g., explosive) sources.

text.zh: 3. 6A001.a.1.c所列压电元件包括由固溶体生长的铌镁酸铅/钛酸铅（Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O_{3}-PbTiO_{3,}或PMN-PT）单晶，或由固溶体生长的铌铟酸铅/铌镁酸铅/钛酸铅（Pb(In_{1/2}Nb_{1/2})O_{3}-Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O_{3}-PbTiO_{3}或PIN-PMN-PT）单晶制成的元件。
text.en: 3. Piezoelectric elements specified in 6A001.a.1.c include those made from lead-magnesium-niobate/lead-titanate (Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O_{3}-PbTiO_{3,} or PMN-PT) single crystals grown from solid solution or lead-indium-niobate/lead-magnesium niobate/lead-titanate (Pb(In_{1/2}Nb_{1/2})O_{3}-Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O_{3}-PbTiO_{3}, or PIN-PMN-PT) single crystals grown from solid solution.

text.zh: a.1.c.1. 工作频率低于10 kHz，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: a.1.c.1. Operating at frequencies below 10 kHz and having any of the following:

text.zh: a.1.c.1.a. 非为以100%占空比连续运行而设计，且辐射的“自由场声源级（SLRMS）”超过(10log(f) + 169.77)dB（参考值为1 m处1 µPa），其中f为10 kHz以下最大发射电压响应（TVR）对应的频率（Hz）；或
text.en: a.1.c.1.a. Not designed for continuous operation at 100% duty cycle and having a radiated 'free-field Source Level (SLRMS)' exceeding (10log(f) + 169.77)dB (reference 1 µPa at 1 m) where f is the frequency in Hertz of maximum Transmitting Voltage Response (TVR) below 10 kHz; or

text.zh: a.1.c.1.b. 为以100%占空比连续运行而设计，且在100%占空比下连续辐射的“自由场声源级（SLRMS）”超过(10log(f) + 159.77)dB（参考值为1 m处1 µPa），其中f为10 kHz以下最大发射电压响应（TVR）对应的频率（Hz）；或
text.en: a.1.c.1.b. Designed for continuous operation at 100% duty cycle and having a continuously radiated 'free-field Source Level (SLRMS)' at 100% duty cycle exceeding (10log(f) + 159.77)dB (reference 1 µPa at 1 m) where f is the frequency in Hertz of maximum Transmitting Voltage Response (TVR) below 10 kHz; or

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A001.a.1.c.1而言，“自由场声源级（SL_{RMS}）”沿最大响应轴并在声发射器远场定义。可根据发射电压响应用下式求得：SL_{RMS} = (TVR + 20log V_{RMS}) dB（参考值为1 m处1 µPa），其中SL_{RMS}为声源级，TVR为发射电压响应，V_{RMS}为发射器驱动电压。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A001.a.1.c.1, the 'free-field Source Level (SL_{RMS})' is defined along the maximum response axis and in the far field of the acoustic projector. It can be obtained from the Transmitting Voltage Response using the following equation: SL_{RMS} = (TVR + 20log V_{RMS}) dB (ref 1µPa at 1 m), where SL_{RMS} is the source level, TVR is the Transmitting Voltage Response and V_{RMS} is the Driving Voltage of the Projector.
a.1.c.2. [Reserved]

text.zh: 特别提示
text.en: N.B.

text.zh: 此前由6A001.a.1.c.2列明的物项，见6A001.a.1.c.1。
text.en: See 6A001.a.1.c.1 for items previously specified in 6A001.a.1.c.2.

text.zh: a.1.c.3. 旁瓣抑制超过22 dB；
text.en: a.1.c.3. Side-lobe suppression exceeding 22 dB;

text.zh: a.1.d. 为确定水面船舶或水下航行器位置而设计，且同时具有以下全部特性的声学系统和设备，以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
text.en: a.1.d. Acoustic systems and equipment, designed to determine the position of surface vessels or underwater vehicles and having all of the following, and “specially designed” “components” therefor:

text.zh: a.1.d.1. 探测距离超过1,000 m；以及
text.en: a.1.d.1. Detection range exceeding 1,000 m; and

text.zh: a.1.d.2. 在1,000 m距离测量时，定位误差小于10 m rms（均方根）；
text.en: a.1.d.2. Determined position error of less than 10 m rms (root mean square) when measured at a range of 1,000 m;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:
6A001.a.1.d includes:

text.zh: a. 在两个或以上信标与水面船舶或水下航行器所携水听器单元之间采用相干“信号处理”的设备；
text.en: a. Equipment using coherent “signal processing” between two or more beacons and the hydrophone unit carried by the surface vessel or underwater vehicle;

text.zh: b. 能够自动校正声速传播误差以计算某一点位置的设备。
text.en: b. Equipment capable of automatically correcting speed-of-sound propagation errors for calculation of a point.

text.zh: a.1.e. 为探测、定位和自动分类游泳者或潜水员而“专门设计”或改装，且同时具有以下全部特性的主动式单体声纳，以及为其“专门设计”的发射和接收声阵列：
text.en: a.1.e. Active individual sonars, “specially designed” or modified to detect, locate and automatically classify swimmers or divers, having all of the following, and “specially designed” transmitting and receiving acoustic arrays therefor:

text.zh: a.1.e.1. 探测距离超过530 m；
text.en: a.1.e.1. Detection range exceeding 530 m;

text.zh: a.1.e.2. 在530 m距离测量时，定位误差小于15 m rms（均方根）；以及
text.en: a.1.e.2. Determined position error of less than 15 m rms (root mean square) when measured at a range of 530 m; and

text.zh: a.1.e.3. 发射脉冲信号带宽超过3 kHz；
text.en: a.1.e.3. Transmitted pulse signal bandwidth exceeding 3 kHz;

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 为军用“专门设计”或改装的潜水员探测系统，见《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR）（22 CFR第121部分）中的《美国军品清单》。
text.en: For diver detection systems “specially designed” or modified for military use, see the U.S. Munitions List in the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR part 121).

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 就6A001.a.1.e而言，如针对不同环境规定了多个探测距离，则采用最大的探测距离。
text.en: For 6A001.a.1.e, where multiple detection ranges are specified for various environments, the greatest detection range is used.

text.zh: a.2. 下列被动式系统、设备以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
text.en: a.2. Passive systems, equipment and “specially designed” “components” therefor, as follows:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A001.a.2也适用于接收设备及为其“专门设计”的部件，无论其在通常应用中是否与独立主动设备相关。
text.en: 6A001.a.2 also applies to receiving equipment, whether or not related in normal application to separate active equipment, and “specially designed” components therefor.

text.zh: a.2.a. 具有下列任一特性的水听器：
text.en: a.2.a. Hydrophones having any of the following:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 为其他设备“专门设计”的水听器的管制状态，由该其他设备的管制状态决定。
text.en: The control status of hydrophones “specially designed” for other equipment is determined by the control status of the other equipment.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 就6A001.a.2.a而言：
text.en: For the purposes of 6A001.a.2.a:

text.zh: 1. 水听器由一个或多个传感元件组成，产生一个声学输出通道。含有多个元件的水听器可称为水听器组。
text.en: 1. Hydrophones consist of one or more sensing elements producing a single acoustic output channel. Those that contain multiple elements can be referred to as a hydrophone group.

text.zh: 2. 为作为被动接收器运行而设计的水下声换能器属于水听器。
text.en: 2. Underwater acoustic transducers designed to operate as passive receivers are hydrophones.

text.zh: a.2.a.1. 采用连续柔性传感元件；
text.en: a.2.a.1. Incorporating continuous flexible sensing elements;

text.zh: a.2.a.2. 采用分立传感元件的柔性组件，元件直径或长度小于20 mm，且元件间距小于20 mm；
text.en: a.2.a.2. Incorporating flexible assemblies of discrete sensing elements with either a diameter or length less than 20 mm and with a separation between elements of less than 20 mm;

text.zh: a.2.a.3. 具有下列任一传感元件：
text.en: a.2.a.3. Having any of the following sensing elements:
a.2.a.3.a. Optical fibers;

text.zh: a.2.a.3.b. 聚偏氟乙烯（PVDF）及其共聚物{P(VDF-TrFE)和P(VDF-TFE)}以外的“压电聚合物薄膜”；
text.en: a.2.a.3.b. 'Piezoelectric polymer films' other than polyvinylidene-fluoride (PVDF) and its co-polymers {P(VDF-TrFE) and P(VDF-TFE)};

text.zh: a.2.a.3.c. “柔性压电复合材料”；
text.en: a.2.a.3.c. 'Flexible piezoelectric composites';

text.zh: a.2.a.3.d. 从固溶体生长的铌镁酸铅/钛酸铅（即Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O_{3}-PbTiO_{3,}或PMN-PT）压电单晶；或
text.en: a.2.a.3.d. Lead-magnesium- niobate/lead-titanate (i.e., Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O_{3}-PbTiO_{3,} or PMN-PT) piezoelectric single crystals grown from solid solution; or

text.zh: a.2.a.3.e. 从固溶体生长的铌铟酸铅/铌镁酸铅/钛酸铅（即Pb(In_{1/2}Nb_{1/2})O_{3}-Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O_{3}-PbTiO_{3}或PIN-PMN-PT）压电单晶；
text.en: a.2.a.3.e. Lead-indium-niobate/lead-magnesium niobate/lead-titanate (i.e., Pb(In_{1/2}Nb_{1/2})O_{3}-Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O_{3}-PbTiO_{3}, or PIN-PMN-PT) piezoelectric single crystals grown from solid solution;

text.zh: a.2.a.4. 在无加速度补偿时，任一深度的“水听器灵敏度”优于−180 dB；
text.en: a.2.a.4. A 'hydrophone sensitivity' better than −180dB at any depth with no acceleration compensation;

text.zh: a.2.a.5. 设计为在超过35 m深度运行，且具有加速度补偿；或
text.en: a.2.a.5. Designed to operate at depths exceeding 35 m with acceleration compensation; or

text.zh: a.2.a.6. 设计为在超过1,000 m深度运行，且在4 kHz以下“水听器灵敏度”优于−230 dB；
text.en: a.2.a.6. Designed for operation at depths exceeding 1,000 m and having a 'hydrophone sensitivity' better than −230 dB below 4 kHz;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就6A001.a.2.a.3.b而言，“压电聚合物薄膜”传感元件由拉伸并固定在支撑框架或卷轴（芯轴）上的极化聚合物薄膜组成。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 6A001.a.2.a.3.b, 'piezoelectric polymer film' sensing elements consist of polarized polymer film that is stretched over and attached to a supporting frame or spool (mandrel).

text.zh: 2. 就6A001.a.2.a.3.c而言，“柔性压电复合材料”传感元件由压电陶瓷颗粒或纤维与电绝缘、声透明的橡胶、聚合物或环氧化合物结合而成，其中该化合物是传感元件的组成部分。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 6A001.a.2.a.3.c, 'flexible piezoelectric composite' sensing elements consist of piezoelectric ceramic particles or fibers combined with an electrically insulating, acoustically transparent rubber, polymer or epoxy compound, where the compound is an integral part of the sensing elements.

text.zh: 3. 就6A001.a.2.a而言，“水听器灵敏度”定义为：将不带前置放大器的水听器传感器置于均方根声压为1 µPa的平面波声场中，其均方根输出电压与1 V均方根参考值之比的以10为底对数的二十倍。例如，−160 dB（参考值1 V/µPa）的水听器在该声场中产生10^{−8} V输出电压，而灵敏度为−180 dB的水听器仅产生10^{−9} V输出。因此，−160 dB优于−180 dB。
text.en: 3. For the purposes of 6A001.a.2.a, 'hydrophone sensitivity' is defined as twenty times the logarithm to the base 10 of the ratio of rms output voltage to a 1 V rms reference, when the hydrophone sensor, without a pre-amplifier, is placed in a plane wave acoustic field with an rms pressure of 1 µPa. For example, a hydrophone of −160 dB (reference 1 V per µPa) would yield an output voltage of 10^{−8} V in such a field, while one of −180 dB sensitivity would yield only 10^{−9} V output. Thus, −160 dB is better than −180 dB.

text.zh: a.2.b. 具有下列任一特性的拖曳声学水听器阵列：
text.en: a.2.b. Towed acoustic hydrophone arrays having any of the following:

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A001.a.2.b而言，水听器阵列由若干水听器组成，提供多个声学输出通道。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A001.a.2.b, hydrophones arrays consist of a number of hydrophones providing multiple acoustic output channels.

text.zh: a.2.b.1. 水听器组间距小于12.5 m，或“能够改装”为水听器组间距小于12.5 m；
text.en: a.2.b.1. Hydrophone group spacing of less than 12.5 m or 'able to be modified' to have hydrophone group spacing of less than 12.5 m;

text.zh: a.2.b.2. 设计为或“能够改装”为在超过35 m深度运行；
text.en: a.2.b.2. Designed or 'able to be modified' to operate at depths exceeding 35m;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A001.a.2.b.2而言，6A001.a.2.b中的“能够改装”是指预留可通过改变布线或互连来改变水听器组间距或工作深度限值的设计。此类预留设计包括：超过导线总数10%的备用导线、水听器组间距调整块，或可调节或控制一个以上水听器组的内部深度限制装置。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A001.a.2.b.2, 'able to be modified' in 6A001.a.2.b means having provisions to allow a change of the wiring or interconnections to alter hydrophone group spacing or operating depth limits. These provisions are: spare wiring exceeding 10% of the number of wires, hydrophone group spacing adjustment blocks or internal depth limiting devices that are adjustable or that control more than one hydrophone group.

text.zh: a.2.b.3. 6A001.a.2.d管制的航向传感器；
text.en: a.2.b.3. Heading sensors controlled by 6A001.a.2.d;

text.zh: a.2.b.4. 纵向增强的阵列软管；
text.en: a.2.b.4. Longitudinally reinforced array hoses;

text.zh: a.2.b.5. 组装后的阵列直径小于40 mm；
text.en: a.2.b.5. An assembled array of less than 40 mm in diameter;
a.2.b.6. [Reserved];

text.zh: a.2.b.7. 具有6A001.a.2.a管制的水听器特性；或
text.en: a.2.b.7. Hydrophone characteristics controlled by 6A001.a.2.a; or

text.zh: a.2.b.8. 6A001.a.2.g所列基于加速度计的水声传感器；
text.en: a.2.b.8. Accelerometer-based hydro-acoustic sensors specified by 6A001.a.2.g;

text.zh: a.2.c. 为拖曳声学水听器阵列“专门设计”、具有“用户可访问的可编程性”及时间域或频率域处理和相关功能的处理设备，包括采用快速傅里叶或其他变换或处理方法进行频谱分析、数字滤波和波束形成；
text.en: a.2.c. Processing equipment, “specially designed” for towed acoustic hydrophone arrays, having “user-accessible programmability” and time or frequency domain processing and correlation, including spectral analysis, digital filtering and beamforming using Fast Fourier or other transforms or processes;

text.zh: a.2.d. 同时具有以下全部特性的航向传感器：
text.en: a.2.d. Heading sensors having all of the following:
a.2.d.1. An “accuracy” of better than ± 0.5°; and

text.zh: a.2.d.2. 设计为在超过35 m深度运行，或具有可调节或可拆卸的深度传感装置，以在超过35 m深度运行；
text.en: a.2.d.2. Designed to operate at depths exceeding 35 m or having an adjustable or removable depth sensing device in order to operate at depths exceeding 35 m;

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 惯性航向系统见7A003.c。
text.en: For inertial heading systems, see 7A003.c.

text.zh: a.2.e. 具有下列任一特性的海底或海湾电缆水听器阵列：
text.en: a.2.e. Bottom or bay-cable hydrophone arrays having any of the following:

text.zh: a.2.e.1. 采用6A001.a.2.a管制水听器；
text.en: a.2.e.1. Incorporating hydrophones controlled by 6A001.a.2.a;

text.zh: a.2.e.2. 采用同时具有以下全部特性的复用水听器组信号模块：
text.en: a.2.e.2. Incorporating multiplexed hydrophone group signal modules having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: a.2.e.2.a. 设计为在超过35 m深度运行，或具有可调节或可拆卸的深度传感装置，以在超过35 m深度运行；以及
text.en: a.2.e.2.a. Designed to operate at depths exceeding 35 m or having an adjustable or removal depth sensing device in order to operate at depths exceeding 35 m; and

text.zh: a.2.e.2.b. 能够在运行中与拖曳声学水听器阵列模块互换；或
text.en: a.2.e.2.b. Capable of being operationally interchanged with towed acoustic hydrophone array modules; or

text.zh: a.2.e.3. 采用6A001.a.2.g所列基于加速度计的水声传感器；
text.en: a.2.e.3. Incorporating accelerometer-based hydro-acoustic sensors specified by 6A001.a.2.g;

text.zh: a.2.f. 为海底或海湾电缆系统“专门设计”、具有“用户可访问的可编程性”及时间域或频率域处理和相关功能的处理设备，包括采用快速傅里叶或其他变换或处理方法进行频谱分析、数字滤波和波束形成；
text.en: a.2.f. Processing equipment, “specially designed” for bottom or bay cable systems, having “user-accessible programmability” and time or frequency domain processing and correlation, including spectral analysis, digital filtering and beamforming using Fast Fourier or other transforms or processes;

text.zh: a.2.g. 同时具有以下全部特性的基于加速度计的水声传感器：
text.en: a.2.g. Accelerometer-based hydro-acoustic sensors having all of the following:

text.zh: a.2.g.1. 由沿三个不同轴排列的三个加速度计组成；
text.en: a.2.g.1. Composed of three accelerometers arranged along three distinct axes;

text.zh: a.2.g.2. 总体“加速度灵敏度”优于48 dB（参考值为每1g对应1,000 mV rms）；
text.en: a.2.g.2. Having an overall 'acceleration sensitivity' better than 48 dB (reference 1,000 mV rms per 1g);

text.zh: a.2.g.3. 设计为在大于35米的深度运行；以及
text.en: a.2.g.3. Designed to operate at depths greater than 35 meters; and

text.zh: a.2.g.4. 工作频率低于20 kHz；
text.en: a.2.g.4. Operating frequency below 20 kHz;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A001.a.2.g不适用于质点速度传感器或地震检波器。
text.en: 6A001.a.2.g does not apply to particle velocity sensors or geophones.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就6A001.a.2.g而言，基于加速度计的水声传感器也称矢量传感器。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 6A001.a.2.g, accelerometer-based hydro-acoustic sensors are also known as vector sensors.

text.zh: 2. 就6A001.a.2.g.2而言，“加速度灵敏度”定义为：将不带前置放大器的水声传感器置于均方根加速度为1 g（即9.81 m/s^{2}）的平面波声场中，其均方根输出电压与1 V均方根参考值之比的以10为底对数的二十倍。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 6A001.a.2.g.2, 'acceleration sensitivity' is defined as twenty times the logarithm to the base 10 of the ratio of rms output voltage to a 1 V rms reference, when the hydro-acoustic sensor, without a preamplifier, is placed in a plane wave acoustic field with an rms acceleration of 1 g (i.e., 9.81 m/s^{2}).

text.zh: b. 为测量设备载体相对于海底的水平速度而设计的下列相关测速和多普勒测速声纳计程仪设备：
text.en: b. Correlation-velocity and Doppler-velocity sonar log equipment designed to measure the horizontal speed of the equipment carrier relative to the sea bed, as follows:

text.zh: b.1. 具有下列任一特性的相关测速声纳计程仪设备：
text.en: b.1. Correlation-velocity sonar log equipment having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.1.a. 设计为在载体与海底间距离超过500 m时运行；或
text.en: b.1.a. Designed to operate at distances between the carrier and the sea bed exceeding 500 m; or

text.zh: b.1.b. 速度“准确度”优于速度的1%；
text.en: b.1.b. Having speed “accuracy” better than 1% of speed;

text.zh: b.2. 速度“准确度”优于速度的1%的多普勒测速声纳计程仪设备；
text.en: b.2. Doppler-velocity sonar log equipment having speed “accuracy” better than 1% of speed;

text.en: Note 1: 6A001.b does not apply to depth sounders limited to any of the following:

text.en: b. Measuring the distance of submerged or buried objects; or

blocks.noteHeading: Note 1: 6A001.b does not apply to depth sounders limited to any of the following:

text.zh: c. 探鱼。
text.en: c. Fish finding.

blocks.noteHeading: Note 1: 6A001.b does not apply to depth sounders limited to any of the following:

text.en: 6A001.b does not apply to equipment “specially designed” for installation on surface vessels.

text.zh: c. [保留]
text.en: c. [Reserved]

text.zh: a. 下列光学探测器：
text.en: a. Optical detectors as follows:

text.zh: a.1. 下列“航天级”固态探测器：
text.en: a.1. “Space-qualified” solid-state detectors as follows:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 就6A002.a.1而言，固态探测器包括“焦平面阵列”。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A002.a.1, solid-state detectors include “focal plane arrays”.

text.zh: a.1.a. 同时具有以下全部特性的“航天级”固态探测器：
text.en: a.1.a. “Space-qualified” solid-state detectors having all of the following:

text.zh: a.1.a.1. 峰值响应波长范围大于10 nm但不超过300 nm；以及
text.en: a.1.a.1. A peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 10 nm but not exceeding 300 nm; and

text.zh: a.1.a.2. 波长超过400 nm时，相对于峰值响应的响应低于0.1%；
text.en: a.1.a.2. A response of less than 0.1% relative to the peak response at a wavelength exceeding 400 nm;

text.zh: a.1.b. 同时具有以下全部特性的“航天级”固态探测器：
text.en: a.1.b. “Space-qualified” solid-state detectors having all of the following:

text.zh: a.1.b.1. 峰值响应波长范围大于900 nm但不超过1,200 nm；以及
text.en: a.1.b.1. A peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 900 nm but not exceeding 1,200 nm; and

text.zh: a.1.b.2. 响应“时间常数”为95 ns或以下；
text.en: a.1.b.2. A response “time constant” of 95 ns or less;

text.zh: a.1.c. 峰值响应波长范围大于1,200 nm但不超过30,000 nm的“航天级”固态探测器；
text.en: a.1.c. “Space-qualified” solid-state detectors having a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 1,200 nm but not exceeding 30,000 nm;

text.zh: a.1.d. 每阵列超过2,048个元件，且峰值响应波长范围大于300 nm但不超过900 nm的“航天级”“焦平面阵列”；
text.en: a.1.d. “Space-qualified” “focal plane arrays” having more than 2,048 elements per array and having a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 300 nm but not exceeding 900 nm;

text.zh: a.2. 下列像增强管及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
text.en: a.2. Image intensifier tubes and “specially designed” “components” therefor, as follows:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A002.a.2不管制真空空间中的电子感测器件仅限于下列任一种的非成像光电倍增管：
text.en: 6A002.a.2 does not control non-imaging photomultiplier tubes having an electron sensing device in the vacuum space limited solely to any of the following:

text.zh: a. 单个金属阳极；或
text.en: a. A single metal anode; or

text.zh: b. 中心间距大于500 µm的金属阳极。
text.en: b. Metal anodes with a center to center spacing greater than 500 µm.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A002.a.2而言，“电荷倍增”是电子图像放大的一种形式，定义为通过碰撞电离增益过程产生电荷载流子。“电荷倍增”传感器可采用像增强管、固态探测器或“焦平面阵列”的形式。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A002.a.2, 'charge multiplication' is a form of electronic image amplification and is defined as the generation of charge carriers as a result of an impact ionization gain process. 'Charge multiplication' sensors may take the form of an image intensifier tube, solid state detector or “focal plane array”.

text.zh: a.2.a. 同时具有以下全部特性的像增强管：
text.en: a.2.a. Image intensifier tubes having all of the following:

text.zh: a.2.a.1. 峰值响应波长范围大于400 nm但不超过1,050 nm；
text.en: a.2.a.1. A peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 400 nm but not exceeding 1,050 nm;

text.zh: a.2.a.2. 采用下列任一种方式进行电子图像放大：
text.en: a.2.a.2. Electron image amplification using any of the following:

text.zh: a.2.a.2.a. 孔距（中心间距）为12 µm或以下的微通道板；或
text.en: a.2.a.2.a. A microchannel plate with a hole pitch (center-to-center spacing) of 12 µm or less; or

text.zh: a.2.a.2.b. 未合并像素间距为500 µm或以下、为通过微通道板以外的方式实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改装的电子感测器件；以及
text.en: a.2.a.2.b. An electron sensing device with a non-binned pixel pitch of 500 µm or less, “specially designed” or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication' other than by a microchannel plate; and

text.zh: a.2.a.3. 下列任一种光电阴极：
text.en: a.2.a.3. Any of the following photocathodes:

text.zh: a.2.a.3.a. 光照灵敏度超过350 µA/lm的多碱光电阴极（例如S-20和S-5）；
text.en: a.2.a.3.a. Multialkali photocathodes (e.g., S-20 and S-5) having a luminous sensitivity exceeding 350 µA/lm;

text.zh: a.2.a.3.b. GaAs或GaInAs光电阴极；或
text.en: a.2.a.3.b. GaAs or GaInAs photocathodes; or

text.zh: a.2.a.3.c. 最大“辐射灵敏度”超过10 mA/W的其他“III-V族化合物”半导体光电阴极；
text.en: a.2.a.3.c. Other “III-V compound” semiconductor photocathodes having a maximum “radiant sensitivity” exceeding 10 mA/W;

text.zh: a.2.b. 同时具有以下全部特性的像增强管：
text.en: a.2.b. Image intensifier tubes having all of the following:

text.zh: a.2.b.1. 峰值响应波长范围大于1,050 nm但不超过1,800 nm；
text.en: a.2.b.1. A peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 1,050 nm but not exceeding 1,800 nm;

text.zh: a.2.b.2. 采用下列任一种方式进行电子图像放大：
text.en: a.2.b.2. Electron image amplification using any of the following:

text.zh: a.2.b.2.a. 孔距（中心间距）为12 µm或以下的微通道板；或
text.en: a.2.b.2.a. A microchannel plate with a hole pitch (center-to-center spacing) of 12 µm or less; or

text.zh: a.2.b.2.b. 未合并像素间距为500 µm或以下、为通过微通道板以外的方式实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改装的电子感测器件；以及
text.en: a.2.b.2.b. An electron sensing device with a non-binned pixel pitch of 500 µm or less, “specially designed” or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication' other than by a microchannel plate; and

text.zh: a.2.b.3. 最大“辐射灵敏度”超过15 mA/W的“III/V族化合物”半导体（例如GaAs或GaInAs）光电阴极和转移电子光电阴极；
text.en: a.2.b.3. “III/V compound” semiconductor (e.g., GaAs or GaInAs) photocathodes and transferred electron photocathodes, having a maximum “radiant sensitivity” exceeding 15 mA/W;

text.zh: a.2.c. 下列“专门设计”的“部件”：
text.en: a.2.c. “Specially designed” “components” as follows:

text.zh: a.2.c.1. 孔距（中心间距）为12 µm或以下的微通道板；
text.en: a.2.c.1. Microchannel plates having a hole pitch (center-to-center spacing) of 12 µm or less;

text.zh: a.2.c.2. 未合并像素间距为500 µm或以下、为通过微通道板以外的方式实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改装的电子感测器件；
text.en: a.2.c.2. An electron sensing device with a non-binned pixel pitch of 500 µm or less, “specially designed” or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication' other than by a microchannel plate;

text.zh: a.2.c.3. “III-V族化合物”半导体（例如GaAs或GaInAs）光电阴极和转移电子光电阴极；
text.en: a.2.c.3. “III-V compound” semiconductor (e.g., GaAs or GaInAs) photocathodes and transferred electron photocathodes;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A002.a.2.c.3不管制设计为实现下列任一最大“辐射灵敏度”的化合物半导体光电阴极：
text.en: 6A002.a.2.c.3 does not control compound semiconductor photocathodes designed to achieve a maximum “radiant sensitivity” of any of the following:

text.zh: a. 在大于400 nm但不超过1,050 nm的波长范围内，峰值响应处为10 mA/W或以下；或
text.en: a. 10 mA/W or less at the peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 400 nm but not exceeding 1,050 nm; or

text.zh: b. 在大于1,050 nm但不超过1,800 nm的波长范围内，峰值响应处为15 mA/W或以下。
text.en: b. 15 mA/W or less at the peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 1,050 nm but not exceeding 1,800 nm.

text.zh: a.3. 下列非“航天级”“焦平面阵列”：
text.en: a.3. Non-“space-qualified” “focal plane arrays” as follows:

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: “微测辐射热计”非“航天级”“焦平面阵列”仅由6A002.a.3.f列明。
text.en: 'Microbolometer' non-“space-qualified” “focal plane arrays” are only specified by 6A002.a.3.f.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A002.a.3而言，线性或二维多元探测器阵列称为“焦平面阵列”；
text.en: For the purposes of 6A002.a.3, linear or two-dimensional multi-element detector arrays are referred to as “focal plane arrays”;
Note 1:

text.zh: 6A002.a.3包括光电导阵列和光伏阵列。
text.en: 6A002.a.3 includes photoconductive arrays and photovoltaic arrays.
Note 2:
6A002.a.3 does not control:

text.zh: a. 使用硫化铅或硒化铅的多元（不超过16个元件）封装光电导单元；
text.en: a. Multi-element (not to exceed 16 elements) encapsulated photoconductive cells using either lead sulphide or lead selenide;

text.zh: b. 使用下列任一材料的热释电探测器：
text.en: b. Pyroelectric detectors using any of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 硫酸三甘氨酸及其变体；
text.en: b.1. Triglycine sulphate and variants;

text.zh: b.2. 钛酸铅镧锆及其变体；
text.en: b.2. Lead-lanthanum-zirconium titanate and variants;

text.zh: b.3. 钽酸锂；
text.en: b.3. Lithium tantalate;

text.zh: b.4. 聚偏氟乙烯及其变体；或
text.en: b.4. Polyvinylidene fluoride and variants; or

text.zh: b.5. 铌酸锶钡及其变体。
text.en: b.5. Strontium barium niobate and variants.

text.zh: c. 为实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改装，并在设计上将超过760 nm波长的最大“辐射灵敏度”限制为10 mA/W或以下，且同时具有以下全部特性的“焦平面阵列”：
text.en: c. “Focal plane arrays” “specially designed” or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication' and limited by design to have a maximum “radiant sensitivity” of 10 mA/W or less for wavelengths exceeding 760 nm, having all of the following:

text.zh: c.1. 采用设计为不可移除或修改的响应限制机制；以及
text.en: c.1. Incorporating a response limiting mechanism designed not to be removed or modified; and

text.zh: c.2. 下列任一种情况：
text.en: c.2. Any of the following:

text.zh: c.2.a. 响应限制机制与探测器元件一体化或相结合；或
text.en: c.2.a. The response limiting mechanism is integral to or combined with the detector element; or

text.zh: c.2.b. “焦平面阵列”仅在响应限制机制就位时才能运行。
text.en: c.2.b. The “focal plane array” is only operable with the response limiting mechanism in place.

text.zh: d. 元件数少于5,130个的热电堆阵列；
text.en: d. Thermopile arrays having less than 5,130 elements;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A002.a.3注2.c.2.a而言，与探测器元件一体化的响应限制机制被设计为一旦移除或修改，探测器即无法运行。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A002.a.3 Note 2.c.2.a, a response limiting mechanism integral to the detector element is designed not to be removed or modified without rendering the detector inoperable.

text.zh: a.3.a. 同时具有以下全部特性的非“航天级”“焦平面阵列”：
text.en: a.3.a. Non-“space-qualified” “focal plane arrays” having all of the following:

text.zh: a.3.a.1. 单个元件的峰值响应波长范围大于900 nm但不超过1,050 nm；以及
text.en: a.3.a.1. Individual elements with a peak response within the wavelength range exceeding 900 nm but not exceeding 1,050 nm; and

text.zh: a.3.a.2. 下列任一特性：
text.en: a.3.a.2. Any of the following:

text.zh: a.3.a.2.a. 响应“时间常数”小于0.5 ns；或
text.en: a.3.a.2.a. A response “time constant” of less than 0.5 ns; or

text.zh: a.3.a.2.b. 为实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改装，且最大“辐射灵敏度”超过10 mA/W；
text.en: a.3.a.2.b. “Specially designed” or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication' and having a maximum “radiant sensitivity” exceeding 10 mA/W;

text.zh: a.3.b. 同时具有以下全部特性的非“航天级”“焦平面阵列”：
text.en: a.3.b. Non-“space-qualified” “focal plane arrays” having all of the following:

text.zh: a.3.b.1. 单个元件的峰值响应波长范围大于1,050 nm但不超过1,200 nm；以及
text.en: a.3.b.1. Individual elements with a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 1,050 nm but not exceeding 1,200 nm; and

text.zh: a.3.b.2. 下列任一特性：
text.en: a.3.b.2. Any of the following:

text.zh: a.3.b.2.a. 响应“时间常数”为95 ns或以下；或
text.en: a.3.b.2.a. A response “time constant” of 95 ns or less; or

text.zh: a.3.b.2.b. 为实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改装，且最大“辐射灵敏度”超过10 mA/W；
text.en: a.3.b.2.b. “Specially designed” or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication' and having a maximum “radiant sensitivity” exceeding 10 mA/W;

text.zh: a.3.c. 单个元件的峰值响应波长范围大于1,200 nm但不超过30,000 nm的非“航天级”非线性（二维）“焦平面阵列”；
text.en: a.3.c. Non-“space-qualified” non-linear (2-dimensional) “focal plane arrays” having individual elements with a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 1,200 nm but not exceeding 30,000 nm;

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 基于硅及其他材料的“微测辐射热计”非“航天级”“焦平面阵列”仅由6A002.a.3.f列明。
text.en: Silicon and other material based 'microbolometer' non-“space-qualified” “focal plane arrays” are only specified by 6A002.a.3.f.

text.zh: a.3.d. 同时具有以下全部特性的非“航天级”线性（一维）“焦平面阵列”：
text.en: a.3.d. Non-“space-qualified” linear (1-dimensional) “focal plane arrays” having all of the following:

text.zh: a.3.d.1. 单个元件的峰值响应波长范围大于1,200 nm但不超过3,000 nm；以及
text.en: a.3.d.1. Individual elements with a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 1,200 nm but not exceeding 3,000 nm; and

text.zh: a.3.d.2. 下列任一特性：
text.en: a.3.d.2. Any of the following:

text.zh: a.3.d.2.a. 探测器元件的“扫描方向”尺寸与“横扫描方向”尺寸之比小于3.8；或
text.en: a.3.d.2.a. A ratio of 'scan direction' dimension of the detector element to the 'cross-scan direction' dimension of the detector element of less than 3.8; or

text.zh: a.3.d.2.b. 在探测器元件中进行信号处理；
text.en: a.3.d.2.b. Signal processing in the detector elements;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A002.a.3.d不管制探测器元件材料仅限于锗的“焦平面阵列”（元件数不超过32个）。
text.en: 6A002.a.3.d does not control “focal plane arrays” (not to exceed 32 elements) having detector elements limited solely to germanium material.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A002.a.3.d而言，“横扫描方向”定义为平行于探测器元件线性阵列的轴，“扫描方向”定义为垂直于探测器元件线性阵列的轴。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A002.a.3.d, 'cross-scan direction' is defined as the axis parallel to the linear array of detector elements and the 'scan direction' is defined as the axis perpendicular to the linear array of detector elements.

text.zh: a.3.e. 单个元件的峰值响应波长范围大于3,000 nm但不超过30,000 nm的非“航天级”线性（一维）“焦平面阵列”；
text.en: a.3.e. Non-“space-qualified” linear (1-dimensional) “focal plane arrays” having individual elements with a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 3,000 nm but not exceeding 30,000 nm;

text.zh: a.3.f. 基于“微测辐射热计”材料的非“航天级”非线性（二维）红外“焦平面阵列”，其单个元件在大于或等于8,000 nm但不超过14,000 nm的波长范围具有未滤波响应；
text.en: a.3.f. Non-“space-qualified” non-linear (2-dimensional) infrared “focal plane arrays” based on 'microbolometer' material having individual elements with an unfiltered response in the wavelength range equal to or exceeding 8,000 nm but not exceeding 14,000 nm;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A002.a.3.f而言，“微测辐射热计”定义为一种热成像探测器，利用吸收红外辐射引起的探测器温度变化产生任何可用信号。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A002.a.3.f, 'microbolometer' is defined as a thermal imaging detector that, as a result of a temperature change in the detector caused by the absorption of infrared radiation, is used to generate any usable signal.

text.zh: a.3.g. 同时具有以下全部特性的非“航天级”“焦平面阵列”：
text.en: a.3.g. Non-“space-qualified” “focal plane arrays” having all of the following:

text.zh: a.3.g.1. 单个探测器元件的峰值响应波长范围大于400 nm但不超过900 nm；
text.en: a.3.g.1. Individual detector elements with a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 400 nm but not exceeding 900 nm;

text.zh: a.3.g.2. 为实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改装，且在超过760 nm波长时最大“辐射灵敏度”超过10 mA/W；以及
text.en: a.3.g.2. “Specially designed” or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication' and having a maximum “radiant sensitivity” exceeding 10 mA/W for wavelengths exceeding 760 nm; and

text.zh: a.3.g.3. 元件数大于32个；
text.en: a.3.g.3. Greater than 32 elements;

text.zh: b. 为遥感应用设计，且具有下列任一特性的“单光谱成像传感器”和“多光谱成像传感器”：
text.en: b. “Monospectral imaging sensors” and “multispectral imaging sensors”, designed for remote sensing applications and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 瞬时视场（IFOV）小于200 µrad（微弧度）；或
text.en: b.1. An Instantaneous-Field-Of-View (IFOV) of less than 200 µrad (microradians); or

text.zh: b.2. 规定工作波长范围大于400 nm但不超过30,000 nm，且同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: b.2. Specified for operation in the wavelength range exceeding 400 nm but not exceeding 30,000 nm and having all the following:

text.zh: b.2.a. 以数字格式提供输出成像数据；以及
text.en: b.2.a. Providing output imaging data in digital format; and

text.zh: b.2.b. 具有下列任一特性：
text.en: b.2.b. Having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.2.b.1. “航天级”；或
text.en: b.2.b.1. “Space-qualified”; or

text.zh: b.2.b.2. 为机载运行设计，使用硅以外的探测器，且IFOV小于2.5 mrad（毫弧度）；
text.en: b.2.b.2. Designed for airborne operation, using other than silicon detectors, and having an IFOV of less than 2.5 mrad (milliradians);

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A002.b.1不管制峰值响应波长范围大于300 nm但不超过900 nm，且仅采用下列任一非“航天级”探测器或非“航天级”“焦平面阵列”的“单光谱成像传感器”：
text.en: 6A002.b.1 does not control “monospectral imaging sensors” with a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 300 nm but not exceeding 900 nm and only incorporating any of the following non-“space-qualified” detectors or non -“space-qualified” “focal plane arrays”:

text.zh: a. 非为实现“电荷倍增”而设计或改装的电荷耦合器件（CCD）；或
text.en: a. Charge Coupled Devices (CCD) not designed or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication'; or

text.zh: b. 非为实现“电荷倍增”而设计或改装的互补金属氧化物半导体（CMOS）器件。
text.en: b. Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) devices not designed or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication'.

text.zh: c. 采用下列任一物项的“直接观察”成像设备：
text.en: c. 'Direct view' imaging equipment incorporating any of the following:

text.zh: c.1. 具有6A002.a.2.a或6A002.a.2.b所列特性的像增强管；
text.en: c.1. Image intensifier tubes having the characteristics listed in 6A002.a.2.a or 6A002.a.2.b;

text.zh: c.2. 具有6A002.a.3所列特性的“焦平面阵列”；或
text.en: c.2. “Focal plane arrays” having the characteristics listed in 6A002.a.3; or

text.zh: c.3. 6A002.a.1所列固态探测器；
text.en: c.3. Solid state detectors specified by 6A002.a.1;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A002.c而言，“直接观察”是指直接向人类观察者呈现可见图像，无需将图像转换为电子信号供电视显示，且不能通过摄影、电子或任何其他方式记录或存储图像的成像设备。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A002.c,'direct view' refers to imaging equipment that presents a visual image to a human observer without converting the image into an electronic signal for television display, and that cannot record or store the image photographically, electronically or by any other means.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A002.c不管制采用GaAs或GaInAs以外光电阴极的下列设备：
text.en: 6A002.c does not control equipment as follows, when incorporating other than GaAs or GaInAs photocathodes:

text.zh: a. 工业或民用入侵报警、交通或工业运动控制或计数系统；
text.en: a. Industrial or civilian intrusion alarm, traffic or industrial movement control or counting systems;

text.zh: b. 医疗设备；
text.en: b. Medical equipment;

text.zh: c. 用于检验、分选或分析材料性能的工业设备；
text.en: c. Industrial equipment used for inspection, sorting or analysis of the properties of materials;

text.zh: d. 工业炉用火焰探测器；
text.en: d. Flame detectors for industrial furnaces;

text.zh: e. 为实验室使用而“专门设计”的设备。
text.en: e. Equipment “specially designed” for laboratory use.

text.zh: d. 下列光学传感器专用支持“部件”：
text.en: d. Special support “components” for optical sensors, as follows:

text.zh: d.1. “航天级”低温制冷机；
text.en: d.1. “Space-qualified” cryocoolers;

text.zh: d.2. 冷源温度低于218 K（−55 °C）的下列非“航天级”低温制冷机：
text.en: d.2. Non-“space-qualified” cryocoolers having a cooling source temperature below 218 K (−55 °C), as follows:

text.zh: d.2.a. 规定平均失效时间（MTTF）或平均故障间隔时间（MTBF）超过2,500小时的闭式循环型；
text.en: d.2.a. Closed cycle type with a specified Mean-Time-To-Failure (MTTF) or Mean-Time-Between-Failures (MTBF), exceeding 2,500 hours;

text.zh: d.2.b. 孔（外）径小于8 mm的焦耳—汤姆孙（JT）自调节微型制冷机；
text.en: d.2.b. Joule-Thomson (JT) self-regulating minicoolers having bore (outside) diameters of less than 8 mm;

text.zh: d.3. 在成分或结构上经特殊制造，或通过涂层改性，以对声、热、惯性、电磁或核辐射敏感的光学传感光纤。
text.en: d.3. Optical sensing fibers specially fabricated either compositionally or structurally, or modified by coating, to be acoustically, thermally, inertially, electromagnetically or nuclear radiation sensitive.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A002.d.3不适用于为钻孔传感应用“专门设计”的封装光学传感光纤。
text.en: 6A002.d.3 does not apply to encapsulated optical sensing fibers “specially designed” for bore hole sensing applications.

text.zh: e. [保留]
text.en: e. [Reserved]

text.zh: f. 为6A002.a.3所列“焦平面阵列”“专门设计”的“读出集成电路”（“ROIC”）。
text.en: f. 'Read-Out Integrated Circuits' ('ROIC') “specially designed” for “focal plane arrays” specified by 6A002.a.3.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A002.f不适用于为民用汽车应用“专门设计”的读出集成电路。
text.en: 6A002.f does not apply to read-out integrated circuits “specially designed” for civil automotive applications.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A002.f而言，“读出集成电路”（“ROIC”）是设计为位于“焦平面阵列”（“FPA”）下方或与其键合、并用于读出（即提取和记录）探测器元件产生信号的集成电路。“ROIC”至少通过提取电荷并执行复用功能读取探测器元件的电荷，同时保留探测器元件的相对空间位置和方向信息，以在“ROIC”内部或外部进行处理。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A002.f, a 'Read-Out Integrated Circuit' ('ROIC') is an integrated circuit designed to underlie or be bonded to a “focal plane array” (“FPA”) and used to read-out (i.e., extract and register) signals produced by the detector elements. At a minimum the 'ROIC' reads the charge from the detector elements by extracting the charge and applying a multiplexing function in a manner that retains the relative spatial position and orientation information of the detector elements for processing inside or outside the 'ROIC'.
