text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 下列仪器用照相机以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
text.en: a. Instrumentation cameras and “specially designed” “components” therefor, as follows:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 对于6A003.a.3至6A003.a.5管制、采用模块化结构的仪器用照相机，应使用按制造商规格可用的插件，根据其最大能力进行评估。
text.en: Instrumentation cameras, controlled by 6A003.a.3 to 6A003.a.5, with modular structures should be evaluated by their maximum capability, using plug-ins available according to the camera manufacturer's specifications.
a.1. [Reserved]
a.2. [Reserved]

text.zh: a.3. 时间分辨率优于50 ns的电子条纹照相机；
text.en: a.3. Electronic streak cameras having temporal resolution better than 50 ns;

text.zh: a.4. 速度超过1,000,000帧/秒的电子分幅照相机；
text.en: a.4. Electronic framing cameras having a speed exceeding 1,000,000 frames/s;

text.zh: a.5. 同时具有以下全部特性的电子照相机：
text.en: a.5. Electronic cameras having all of the following:

text.zh: a.5.a. 电子快门速度（选通能力）每完整帧小于1 µs；以及
text.en: a.5.a. An electronic shutter speed (gating capability) of less than 1µs per full frame; and

text.zh: a.5.b. 读出时间允许帧速率超过每秒125个完整帧；
text.en: a.5.b. A read out time allowing a framing rate of more than 125 full frames per second;

text.zh: a.6. 同时具有以下全部特性的插件：
text.en: a.6. Plug-ins having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: a.6.a. 为采用模块化结构且受6A003.a管制的仪器用照相机“专门设计”；以及
text.en: a.6.a. “Specially designed” for instrumentation cameras which have modular structures and that are controlled by 6A003.a; and

text.zh: a.6.b. 按制造商规格，使这些照相机能够达到6A003.a.3、6A003.a.4或6A003.a.5所列特性；
text.en: a.6.b. Enabling these cameras to meet the characteristics specified by 6A003.a.3, 6A003.a.4 or 6A003.a.5, according to the manufacturer's specifications;

text.zh: b. 下列成像照相机：
text.en: b. Imaging cameras as follows:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A003.b不管制为电视广播“专门设计”的电视或视频摄像机。
text.en: 6A003.b does not control television or video cameras “specially designed” for television broadcasting.

text.zh: b.1. 采用固态传感器，峰值响应波长范围大于10 nm但不超过30,000 nm，且同时具有以下全部特性的视频摄像机：
text.en: b.1. Video cameras incorporating solid state sensors, having a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 10 nm, but not exceeding 30,000 nm and having all of the following:

text.zh: b.1.a. 具有下列任一特性：
text.en: b.1.a. Having any of the following:

text.zh: b.1.a.1. 单色（黑白）摄像机的每个固态阵列超过4 x 10^{6}个“有效像素”；
text.en: b.1.a.1. More than 4 x 10^{6} “active pixels” per solid state array for monochrome (black and white) cameras;

text.zh: b.1.a.2. 采用三个固态阵列的彩色摄像机，每个固态阵列超过4 x 10^{6}个“有效像素”；或
text.en: b.1.a.2. More than 4 x 10^{6} “active pixels” per solid state array for color cameras incorporating three solid state arrays; or

text.zh: b.1.a.3. 采用一个固态阵列的固态阵列彩色摄像机，超过12 x 10^{6}个“有效像素”；以及
text.en: b.1.a.3. More than 12 x 10^{6} “active pixels” for solid state array color cameras incorporating one solid state array; and

text.zh: b.1.b. 具有下列任一特性：
text.en: b.1.b. Having any of the following:

text.zh: b.1.b.1. 6A004.a管制的光学反射镜；
text.en: b.1.b.1. Optical mirrors controlled by 6A004.a.;

text.zh: b.1.b.2. 6A004.d管制的光学控制设备；或
text.en: b.1.b.2. Optical control equipment controlled by 6A004.d.; or

text.zh: b.1.b.3. 能够标注内部生成的“摄像机跟踪数据”；
text.en: b.1.b.3. The capability for annotating internally generated 'camera tracking data';

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就6A003.b.1而言，应按用于捕获运动图像的最大“有效像素”数量评估数字视频摄像机。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 6A003.b.1, digital video cameras should be evaluated by the maximum number of “active pixels” used for capturing moving images.

text.zh: 2. 就6A003.b.1.b.3而言，“摄像机跟踪数据”是确定摄像机视线相对于地球的方向所需的信息，包括：(1) 摄像机视线与地球磁场方向形成的水平角；以及(2) 摄像机视线与地球地平线之间的垂直角。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 6A003.b.1.b.3, 'camera tracking data' is the information necessary to define camera line of sight orientation with respect to the earth. This includes: (1) the horizontal angle the camera line of sight makes with respect to the earth's magnetic field direction and; (2) the vertical angle between the camera line of sight and the earth's horizon.

text.zh: b.2. 同时具有以下全部特性的扫描照相机和扫描照相机系统：
text.en: b.2. Scanning cameras and scanning camera systems, having all of the following:

text.zh: b.2.a. 峰值响应波长范围大于10 nm但不超过30,000 nm；
text.en: b.2.a. A peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 10 nm, but not exceeding 30,000 nm;

text.zh: b.2.b. 每阵列超过8,192个元件的线性探测器阵列；以及
text.en: b.2.b. Linear detector arrays with more than 8,192 elements per array; and

text.zh: b.2.c. 在一个方向上进行机械扫描；
text.en: b.2.c. Mechanical scanning in one direction;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A003.b.2不适用于为下列任一用途“专门设计”的扫描照相机和扫描照相机系统：
text.en: 6A003.b.2 does not apply to scanning cameras and scanning camera systems, “specially designed” for any of the following:

text.zh: a. 工业或民用复印机；
text.en: a. Industrial or civilian photocopiers;

text.zh: b. 为民用、固定式、近距离扫描应用（例如复制文件、艺术品或照片中的图像或印刷内容）“专门设计”的图像扫描仪；或
text.en: b. Image scanners “specially designed” for civil, stationary, close proximity scanning applications (e.g., reproduction of images or print contained in documents, artwork, or photographs); or

text.zh: c. 医疗设备。
text.en: c. Medical equipment.

text.zh: b.3. 采用具有6A002.a.2.a或6A002.a.2.b所列特性的像增强管的成像照相机；
text.en: b.3. Imaging cameras incorporating image intensifier tubes having the characteristics listed in 6A002.a.2.a or 6A002.a.2.b;

text.zh: b.4. 采用“焦平面阵列”且具有下列任一特性的成像照相机：
text.en: b.4. Imaging cameras incorporating “focal plane arrays” having any of the following:

text.zh: b.4.a. 采用6A002.a.3.a至6A002.a.3.e管制的“焦平面阵列”；
text.en: b.4.a. Incorporating “focal plane arrays” controlled by 6A002.a.3.a to 6A002.a.3.e;

text.zh: b.4.b. 采用6A002.a.3.f管制的“焦平面阵列”；或
text.en: b.4.b. Incorporating “focal plane arrays” controlled by 6A002.a.3.f; or

text.zh: b.4.c. 采用6A002.a.3.g管制的“焦平面阵列”；
text.en: b.4.c. Incorporating “focal plane arrays” controlled by 6A002.a.3.g;
Note 1:

text.zh: 6A003.b.4所述成像照相机包括“焦平面阵列”与读出集成电路以外的足够“信号处理”电子器件的组合，使其供电后至少能够输出模拟或数字信号。
text.en: Imaging cameras described in 6A003.b.4 include “focal plane arrays” combined with sufficient “signal processing” electronics, beyond the read out integrated circuit, to enable as a minimum the output of an analog or digital signal once power is supplied.
Note 2:

text.zh: 6A003.b.4.a不管制采用12个或以下元件的线性“焦平面阵列”、元件内部不使用时间延迟积分，且为下列任一用途设计的成像照相机：
text.en: 6A003.b.4.a does not control imaging cameras incorporating linear “focal plane arrays” with 12 elements or fewer, not employing time-delay-and-integration within the element and designed for any of the following:

text.zh: a. 工业或民用入侵报警、交通或工业运动控制或计数系统；
text.en: a. Industrial or civilian intrusion alarm, traffic or industrial movement control or counting systems;

text.zh: b. 用于检查或监测建筑物、设备或工业过程热流的工业设备；
text.en: b. Industrial equipment used for inspection or monitoring of heat flows in buildings, equipment, or industrial processes;

text.zh: c. 用于检验、分选或分析材料性能的工业设备；
text.en: c. Industrial equipment used for inspection, sorting or analysis of the properties of materials;

text.zh: d. 为实验室使用“专门设计”的设备；或
text.en: d. Equipment “specially designed” for laboratory use; or

text.zh: e. 医疗设备。
text.en: e. Medical equipment.
Note 3:

text.zh: 6A003.b.4.b不管制具有下列任一特性的成像照相机：
text.en: 6A003.b.4.b does not control imaging cameras having any of the following:

text.zh: a. 最大帧率小于或等于9 Hz；
text.en: a. A maximum frame rate equal to or less than 9 Hz;

text.zh: b. 同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: b. Having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 水平或垂直方向中较小的“瞬时视场（IFOV）”至少为2 mrad（毫弧度）；
text.en: 1. Having a minimum horizontal or vertical 'Instantaneous-Field-of-View (IFOV)' of at least 2 mrad (milliradians);

text.zh: 2. 采用设计为不可拆卸的定焦镜头；
text.en: 2. Incorporating a fixed focal-length lens that is not designed to be removed;

text.zh: 3. 不含“直接观察”显示器；以及
text.en: 3. Not incorporating a 'direct view' display; and

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A003.b.4注3.b.3而言，“直接观察”是指在红外光谱范围工作，使用含有任何光安全机制的近眼微型显示器向人类观察者呈现可见图像的成像照相机。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A003.b.4 Note 3.b.3, 'direct view' refers to an imaging camera operating in the infrared spectrum that presents a visual image to a human observer using a near-to-eye micro display incorporating any light-security mechanism.

text.zh: 4. 具有下列任一特性：
text.en: 4. Having any of the following:

text.zh: a. 不具备获取所探测视场可视图像的功能；或
text.en: a. No facility to obtain a viewable image of the detected field-of-view; or

text.zh: b. 照相机仅为单一类型应用设计，且设计为用户不可修改；或
text.en: b. The camera is designed for a single kind of application and designed not to be user modified; or

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A003.b.4注3.b.1而言，“瞬时视场（IFOV）”为“水平IFOV”和“垂直IFOV”中的较小值。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A003.b.4 Note 3.b.1, 'Instantaneous-Field-of-View (IFOV)' is the lesser figure of the 'Horizontal IFOV' or the 'Vertical IFOV'.

text.zh: “水平IFOV” = 水平视场（FOV）/水平探测器元件数量
text.en: 'Horizontal IFOV' = horizontal Field-of-View (FOV)/number of horizontal detector elements

text.zh: “垂直IFOV” = 垂直视场（FOV）/垂直探测器元件数量。
text.en: 'Vertical IFOV'= vertical Field-of-View (FOV)/number of vertical detector elements.

text.zh: c. 照相机为安装于民用载客陆地车辆而“专门设计”，且同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: c. The camera is “specially designed” for installation into a civilian passenger land vehicle and having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 照相机在车辆内的位置和配置仅用于协助驾驶员安全驾驶车辆；
text.en: 1. The placement and configuration of the camera within the vehicle are solely to assist the driver in the safe operation of the vehicle;

text.zh: 2. 仅在安装于下列任一载体或设施中时可运行：
text.en: 2. Is operable only when installed in any of the following:

text.zh: a. 其预定安装的民用载客陆地车辆，且车辆重量（总重）小于4,500 kg；或
text.en: a. The civilian passenger land vehicle for which it was intended and the vehicle weighs less than 4,500 kg (gross vehicle weight); or

text.zh: b. “专门设计”且经授权的维护测试设施；以及
text.en: b. A “specially designed”, authorized maintenance test facility; and

text.zh: 3. 含有主动机制，在照相机从其预定安装的车辆中移除时强制使其停止工作。
text.en: 3. Incorporates an active mechanism that forces the camera not to function when it is removed from the vehicle for which it was intended.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 必要时，应请求向工业与安全局提供物项详细资料，以核实是否符合本6A003.b.4.b注中的注3.b.4和注3.c所述条件。
text.en: When necessary, details of the items will be provided, upon request, to the Bureau of Industry and Security in order to ascertain compliance with the conditions described in Note 3.b.4 and Note 3.c in this Note to 6A003.b.4.b.
Note 4:

text.zh: 6A003.b.4.c不适用于具有下列任一特性的“成像照相机”：
text.en: 6A003.b.4.c does not apply to 'imaging cameras' having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: a. 同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: a. Having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 照相机为作为集成部件安装于室内、使用墙壁插座供电的系统或设备而“专门设计”，且设计上仅限于下列单一类型应用：
text.en: 1. Where the camera is “specially designed” for installation as an integrated component into indoor and wall-plug-operated systems or equipment, limited by design for a single kind of application, as follows:

text.zh: a. 工业过程监测、质量控制或材料性能分析；
text.en: a. Industrial process monitoring, quality control, or analysis of the properties of materials;

text.zh: b. 为科学研究“专门设计”的实验室设备；
text.en: b. Laboratory equipment “specially designed” for scientific research;

text.zh: c. 医疗设备；
text.en: c. Medical equipment;

text.zh: d. 金融欺诈检测设备；以及
text.en: d. Financial fraud detection equipment; and

text.zh: 2. 仅在安装于下列任一系统、设备或设施中时可运行：
text.en: 2. Is only operable when installed in any of the following:

text.zh: a. 其预定安装的系统或设备；或
text.en: a. The system(s) or equipment for which it was intended; or

text.zh: b. “专门设计”且经授权的维护设施；以及
text.en: b. A “specially designed,” authorized maintenance facility; and

text.zh: 3. 含有主动机制，在照相机从其预定安装的系统或设备中移除时强制使其停止工作；
text.en: 3. Incorporates an active mechanism that forces the camera not to function when it is removed from the system(s) or equipment for which it was intended;

text.zh: b. 照相机为安装于民用载客陆地车辆或客货渡轮而“专门设计”，且同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: b. Where the camera is “specially designed” for installation into a civilian passenger land vehicle or passenger and vehicle ferries and having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 照相机在车辆或渡轮内的位置和配置仅用于协助驾驶员或操作员安全操作车辆或渡轮；
text.en: 1. The placement and configuration of the camera within the vehicle or ferry are solely to assist the driver or operator in the safe operation of the vehicle or ferry;

text.zh: 2. 仅在安装于下列任一系统、设备或设施中时可运行：
text.en: 2. Is only operable when installed in any of the following:

text.zh: a. 其预定安装的民用载客陆地车辆，且车辆重量（总重）小于4,500 kg；
text.en: a. The civilian passenger land vehicle for which it was intended and the vehicle weighs less than 4,500 kg (gross vehicle weight);

text.zh: b. 其预定安装的客货渡轮，且总长（LOA）为65 m或以上；或
text.en: b. The passenger and vehicle ferry for which it was intended and having a length overall (LOA) 65 m or greater; or

text.zh: c. “专门设计”且经授权的维护测试设施；以及
text.en: c. A “specially designed”, authorized maintenance test facility; and

text.zh: 3. 含有主动机制，在照相机从其预定安装的车辆中移除时强制使其停止工作；
text.en: 3. Incorporates an active mechanism that forces the camera not to function when it is removed from the vehicle for which it was intended;

text.zh: c. 设计上将超过760 nm波长的最大“辐射灵敏度”限制为10 mA/W或以下，且同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: c. Limited by design to have a maximum “radiant sensitivity” of 10 mA/W or less for wavelengths exceeding 760 nm, having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 采用设计为不可移除或修改的响应限制机制；以及
text.en: 1. Incorporating a response limiting mechanism designed not to be removed or modified; and

text.zh: 2. 含有主动机制，在响应限制机制被移除时强制使照相机停止工作；以及
text.en: 2. Incorporates an active mechanism that forces the camera not to function when the response limiting mechanism is removed; and

text.zh: 3. 并非为水下使用而“专门设计”或改装；或
text.en: 3. Not “specially designed” or modified for underwater use; or

text.zh: d. 同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: d. Having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 不含“直接观察”或电子图像显示器；
text.en: 1. Not incorporating a 'direct view' or electronic image display;

text.zh: 2. 不具备输出所探测视场可视图像的功能；
text.en: 2. Has no facility to output a viewable image of the detected field of view;

text.zh: 3. “焦平面阵列”仅在安装于其预定照相机中时可运行；以及
text.en: 3. The “focal plane array” is only operable when installed in the camera for which it was intended; and

text.zh: 4. “焦平面阵列”含有主动机制，在从其预定照相机中移除时强制使其永久无法运行。
text.en: 4. The “focal plane array” incorporates an active mechanism that forces it to be permanently inoperable when removed from the camera for which it was intended.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 必要时，应请求向工业与安全局提供物项详细资料，以核实是否符合上述注4所述条件。
text.en: When necessary, details of the item will be provided, upon request, to the Bureau of Industry and Security in order to ascertain compliance with the conditions described in Note 4 above.

text.zh: b.5. 采用6A002.a.1所列固态探测器的成像照相机。
text.en: b.5. Imaging cameras incorporating solid-state detectors specified by 6A002.a.1.

text.zh: 受管制物项清单
text.en: List of Items Controlled

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 为光刻“设备”“专门设计”的光学反射镜或“非球面光学元件”，见ECCN 3B001。(2) “受ITAR管辖”的万向架，见USML第XII(e)类。(3) 另见6A994。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) For optical mirrors or 'aspheric optical elements' “specially designed” for lithography “equipment,” see ECCN 3B001. (2) See USML Category XII(e) for gimbals “subject to the ITAR.” (3) See also 6A994.

text.zh: 相关定义：“非球面光学元件”是指光学系统中使用的任何元件，其一个或多个成像表面设计为偏离理想球面的形状。
text.en: Related Definitions: An 'aspheric optical element' is any element used in an optical system whose imaging surface or surfaces are designed to depart from the shape of an ideal sphere.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 下列光学反射镜：
text.en: a. Optical mirrors (reflectors) as follows:

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A004.a而言，激光诱导损伤阈值（LIDT）按ISO 21254-1:2011测量。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A004.a, Laser Induced Damage Threshold (LIDT) is measured according to ISO 21254-1:2011.

text.zh: a.1. 有效光学口径大于10 mm且具有下列任一特性的“可变形反射镜”，以及为其“专门设计”的部件：
text.en: a.1. 'Deformable mirrors' having an active optical aperture greater than 10 mm and having any of the following, and “specially designed” components therefor:

text.zh: a.1.a. 同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: a.1.a. Having all the following:

text.zh: a.1.a.1. 机械谐振频率为750 Hz或以上；以及
text.en: a.1.a.1. A mechanical resonant frequency of 750 Hz or more; and

text.zh: a.1.a.2. 超过200个致动器；或
text.en: a.1.a.2. More than 200 actuators; or

text.zh: a.1.b. 激光诱导损伤阈值（LIDT）符合下列任一条件：
text.en: a.1.b. A Laser Induced Damage Threshold (LIDT) being any of the following:

text.zh: a.1.b.1. 使用“连续波激光器”时大于1 kW/cm^{2}；或
text.en: a.1.b.1. Greater than 1 kW/cm^{2} using a “CW laser”; or

text.zh: a.1.b.2. 使用重复频率20 Hz的20 ns“激光”脉冲时大于2 J/cm^{2}；
text.en: a.1.b.2. Greater than 2 J/cm^{2} using 20 ns “laser” pulses at 20 Hz repetition rate;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:
For the purposes of 6A004.a.1:

text.zh: 1. “可变形反射镜”是具有下列任一特性的反射镜：
text.en: 1. 'Deformable mirrors' are mirrors having any of the following:

text.zh: a. 单一连续光学反射面，通过施加独立扭矩或力使其动态变形，以补偿入射至该镜面的光学波形畸变；或
text.en: a. A single continuous optical reflecting surface which is dynamically deformed by the application of individual torques or forces to compensate for distortions in the optical waveform incident upon the mirror; or

text.zh: b. 多个光学反射元件，可通过施加扭矩或力独立动态调整位置，以补偿入射至该镜面的光学波形畸变。
text.en: b. Multiple optical reflecting elements that can be individually and dynamically repositioned by the application of torques or forces to compensate for distortions in the optical waveform incident upon the mirror.

text.zh: 2. “可变形反射镜”也称自适应光学反射镜。
text.en: 2. 'Deformable mirrors' are also known as adaptive optic mirrors.

text.zh: a.2. 平均“等效密度”小于30 kg/m^{2}且总质量超过10 kg的轻量化整体反射镜；
text.en: a.2. Lightweight monolithic mirrors having an average “equivalent density” of less than 30 kg/m^{2} and a total mass exceeding 10 kg;

text.zh: a.3. 平均“等效密度”小于30 kg/m^{2}且总质量超过2 kg的轻量化“复合材料”或泡沫反射镜结构；
text.en: a.3. Lightweight “composite” or foam mirror structures having an average “equivalent density” of less than 30 kg/m^{2} and a total mass exceeding 2 kg;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A004.a.2和6A004.a.3不适用于为地面定日镜装置引导太阳辐射而“专门设计”的反射镜。
text.en: 6A004.a.2 and 6A004.a.3 do not apply to mirrors “specially designed” to direct solar radiation for terrestrial heliostat installations.

text.zh: a.4. 为6A004.d.2.a所列光束操纵反射镜台“专门设计”，平面度为λ/10或更优（λ等于633 nm），且具有下列任一特性的反射镜：
text.en: a.4. Mirrors “specially designed” for beam steering mirror stages specified in 6A004.d.2.a with a flatness of λ/10 or better (λ is equal to 633 nm) and having any of the following:

text.zh: a.4.a. 直径或长轴长度大于或等于100 mm；或
text.en: a.4.a. Diameter or major axis length greater than or equal to 100 mm; or

text.zh: a.4.b. 同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: a.4.b. Having all of the following:

text.zh: a.4.b.1. 直径或长轴长度大于50 mm但小于100 mm；以及
text.en: a.4.b.1. Diameter or major axis length greater than 50 mm but less than 100 mm; and

text.zh: a.4.b.2. 激光诱导损伤阈值（LIDT）符合下列任一条件：
text.en: a.4.b.2. A Laser Induced Damage Threshold (LIDT) being any of the following:

text.zh: a.4.b.2.a. 使用“连续波激光器”时大于10 kW/cm2；或
text.en: a.4.b.2.a. Greater than 10 kW/cm2 using a “CW laser”; or

text.zh: a.4.b.2.b. 使用重复频率20 Hz的20 ns“激光”脉冲时大于20 J/cm2；
text.en: a.4.b.2.b. Greater than 20 J/cm2 using 20 ns “laser” pulses at 20 Hz repetition rate;

text.zh: 特别提示
text.en: N.B.

text.zh: 为光刻设备“专门设计”的光学反射镜，见3B001。
text.en: For optical mirrors “specially designed” for lithography equipment, see 3B001.

text.zh: b. 由硒化锌（ZnSe）或硫化锌（ZnS）制成，在大于3,000 nm但不超过25,000 nm的波长范围透射，且具有下列任一特性的光学“部件”：
text.en: b. Optical “components” made from zinc selenide (ZnSe) or zinc sulfide (ZnS) with transmission in the wavelength range exceeding 3,000 nm but not exceeding 25,000 nm and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 体积超过100 cm^{3}；或
text.en: b.1. Exceeding 100 cm^{3} in volume; or

text.zh: b.2. 直径或长轴长度超过80 mm，且厚度（深度）超过20 mm；
text.en: b.2. Exceeding 80 mm in diameter or length of major axis and 20 mm in thickness (depth);

text.zh: c. 下列光学系统用“航天级”“部件”：
text.en: c. “Space-qualified” “components” for optical systems, as follows:

text.zh: c.1. 经轻量化，与相同口径和厚度的实心坯料相比，“等效密度”低于20%的“部件”；
text.en: c.1. “Components” lightweighted to less than 20% “equivalent density” compared with a solid blank of the same aperture and thickness;

text.zh: c.2. 未加工衬底、具有表面涂层（单层或多层、金属或介质、导电、半导电或绝缘）或保护膜的加工后衬底；
text.en: c.2. Raw substrates, processed substrates having surface coatings (single-layer or multi-layer, metallic or dielectric, conducting, semiconducting or insulating) or having protective films;

text.zh: c.3. 设计为在太空组装成光学系统的反射镜分段或组件，该光学系统的集光口径等于或大于直径1 m的单一光学元件；
text.en: c.3. Segments or assemblies of mirrors designed to be assembled in space into an optical system with a collecting aperture equivalent to or larger than a single optic 1 m in diameter;

text.zh: c.4. 由“复合材料”制造、在任一坐标方向的线性热膨胀系数小于或等于5 × 10^{−6}/K的“部件”；
text.en: c.4. “Components” manufactured from “composite” materials having a coefficient of linear thermal expansion, in any coordinate direction, equal to or less than 5 × 10^{−6}/K;

text.zh: d. 下列光学控制设备：
text.en: d. Optical control equipment as follows:

text.zh: d.1. 为保持6A004.c.1或6A004.c.3管制“航天级”“部件”的面形或方向而“专门设计”的设备；
text.en: d.1. Equipment “specially designed” to maintain the surface figure or orientation of the “space-qualified” “components” controlled by 6A004.c.1 or 6A004.c.3;

text.zh: d.2. 下列操纵、跟踪、稳定和谐振腔对准设备：
text.en: d.2. Steering, tracking, stabilisation and resonator alignment equipment as follows:

text.zh: d.2.a. 设计为承载直径或长轴长度大于50 mm的反射镜，且同时具有以下全部特性的光束操纵反射镜台，以及为其“专门设计”的电子控制设备：
text.en: d.2.a. Beam steering mirror stages designed to carry mirrors having diameter or major axis length greater than 50 mm and having all of the following, and “specially designed” electronic control equipment therefor:

text.zh: d.2.a.1. 最大角行程为±26 mrad或以上；
text.en: d.2.a.1. A maximum angular travel of ±26 mrad or more;

text.zh: d.2.a.2. 机械谐振频率为500 Hz或以上；以及
text.en: d.2.a.2. A mechanical resonant frequency of 500 Hz or more; and

text.zh: d.2.a.3. 角“准确度”为10 µrad（微弧度）或以下（更优）；
text.en: d.2.a.3. An angular “accuracy” of 10 µrad (microradians) or less (better);

text.zh: d.2.b. 带宽大于或等于100 Hz、且“准确度”为10 µrad或以下（更优）的谐振腔对准设备；
text.en: d.2.b. Resonator alignment equipment having bandwidths equal to or more than 100 Hz and an “accuracy” of 10 µrad or less (better);

text.zh: d.3. 同时具有以下全部特性的万向架：
text.en: d.3. Gimbals having all of the following:

text.zh: d.3.a. 最大回转角超过5°；
text.en: d.3.a. A maximum slew exceeding 5°;

text.zh: d.3.b. 带宽为100 Hz或以上；
text.en: d.3.b. A bandwidth of 100 Hz or more;

text.zh: d.3.c. 角指向误差为200 µrad（微弧度）或以下；以及
text.en: d.3.c. Angular pointing errors of 200 µrad (microradians) or less; and

text.zh: d.3.d. 具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.3.d. Having any of the following:

text.zh: d.3.d.1. 直径或长轴长度超过0.15 m但不超过1 m，且角加速度能够超过2 rad（弧度）/s^{2}；或
text.en: d.3.d.1. Exceeding 0.15 m but not exceeding 1 m in diameter or major axis length and capable of angular accelerations exceeding 2 rad (radians)/s^{2}; or

text.zh: d.3.d.2. 直径或长轴长度超过1 m，且角加速度能够超过0.5 rad（弧度）/s^{2}；
text.en: d.3.d.2. Exceeding 1 m in diameter or major axis length and capable of angular accelerations exceeding 0.5 rad (radians)/s^{2};
d.4. [Reserved]

text.zh: e. 同时具有以下全部特性的“非球面光学元件”：
text.en: e. 'Aspheric optical elements' having all of the following:

text.zh: e.1. 光学口径的最大尺寸大于400 mm；
text.en: e.1. Largest dimension of the optical-aperture greater than 400 mm;

text.zh: e.2. 在采样长度大于或等于1 mm时，表面粗糙度小于1 nm（rms）；以及
text.en: e.2. Surface roughness less than 1 nm (rms) for sampling lengths equal to or greater than 1 mm; and

text.zh: e.3. 在25 °C时，线性热膨胀系数绝对值小于3 × 10^{−6}/K；
text.en: e.3. Coefficient of linear thermal expansion's absolute magnitude less than 3 × 10^{−6}/K at 25 °C;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 1. 就6A004.e而言，“非球面光学元件”是指光学系统中使用的任何元件，其一个或多个成像表面设计为偏离理想球面的形状。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 6A004.e, an 'aspheric optical element' is any element used in an optical system whose imaging surface or surfaces are designed to depart from the shape of an ideal sphere.

text.zh: 2. 就6A004.e.2而言，制造商无需测量表面粗糙度，除非设计或制造该光学元件的意图是达到或超过管制参数。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 6A004.e.2, manufacturers are not required to measure the surface roughness unless the optical element was designed or manufactured with the intent to meet, or exceed, the control parameter.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A004.e不管制具有下列任一特性的“非球面光学元件”：
text.en: 6A004.e does not control 'aspheric optical elements' having any of the following:

text.zh: a. 最大光学口径尺寸小于1 m，且焦距与口径之比大于或等于4.5:1；
text.en: a. Largest optical-aperture dimension less than 1 m and focal length to aperture ratio equal to or greater than 4.5:1;

text.zh: b. 最大光学口径尺寸大于或等于1 m，且焦距与口径之比大于或等于7:1；
text.en: b. Largest optical-aperture dimension equal to or greater than 1 m and focal length to aperture ratio equal to or greater than 7:1;

text.zh: c. 设计为菲涅耳、蝇眼、条纹、棱镜或衍射光学元件；
text.en: c. Designed as Fresnel, flyeye, stripe, prism or diffractive optical elements;

text.zh: d. 由25 °C时线性热膨胀系数大于2.5 × 10^{−6}/K的硼硅酸盐玻璃制造；或
text.en: d. Fabricated from borosilicate glass having a coefficient of linear thermal expansion greater than 2.5 × 10^{−6}/K at 25 °C; or

text.zh: e. 具有内表面反射能力的X射线光学元件（例如管式反射镜）。
text.en: e. An x-ray optical element having inner mirror capabilities (e.g., tube-type mirrors).

text.zh: f. 同时具有以下全部特性的动态波前测量设备：
text.en: f. Dynamic wavefront measuring equipment having all of the following:

text.zh: f.1. “帧率”大于或等于1 kHz；以及
text.en: f.1. 'Frame rates' equal to or more than 1 kHz; and

text.zh: f.2. 在设计波长下，波前准确度为λ/20或以下（更优）。
text.en: f.2. A wavefront accuracy equal to or less (better) than λ/20 at the designed wavelength.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A004.f而言，“帧率”是“焦平面阵列”中全部“有效像素”进行积分，以记录波前传感器光学系统所投射图像的频率。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A004.f, 'frame rate' is a frequency at which all “active pixels” in the “focal plane array” are integrated for recording images projected by the wavefront sensor optics.

text.zh: 6A005 下列“激光器”、“部件”和光学设备（见管制物项清单），不包括受核管理委员会出口许可权限管辖的物项（见10 CFR第110部分）。
text.en: 6A005 “Lasers”, “components” and optical equipment, as follows (see List of Items Controlled), excluding items that are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).

text.en: $3000 for all other items

text.zh: GBS：适用于6A005.b.6.d.2（6A005.b.6.d.2.b除外）管制的掺钕（玻璃除外）“激光器”，其输出波长大于1,000 nm但不超过1,100 nm，平均或连续波输出功率不超过2 kW，且以脉冲激励、非“调Q”多横模，或连续激励多横模运行；6A005.c.1、c.2和c.3管制的染料及液体激光器，但“脉冲持续时间”小于100 ns时，平均输出功率超过1 W且重复频率超过1 kHz的脉冲单纵模振荡器除外；6A005.d.2管制且连续波最大额定单模或多模输出功率不超过10 kW的CO“激光器”；6A005.d.3管制的CO_{2}或CO/CO_{2}“激光器”，其输出波长在9,000至11,000 nm范围内，脉冲输出不超过每脉冲2 J，且最大额定平均单模或多模输出功率不超过5 kW；以及6A005.d.3管制、以连续波多横模运行且连续波输出功率不超过15 kW的CO_{2}“激光器”。
text.en: GBS: Neodymium-doped (other than glass) “lasers” controlled by 6A005.b.6.d.2 (except 6A005.b.6.d.2.b) that have an output wavelength exceeding 1,000 nm, but not exceeding 1,100 nm, and an average or CW output power not exceeding 2 kW, and operate in a pulse-excited, non- “Q-switched” multiple-transverse mode, or in a continuously excited, multiple-transverse mode; Dye and Liquid Lasers controlled by 6A005.c.1, c.2 and c.3, except for a pulsed single longitudinal mode oscillator having an average output power exceeding 1 W and a repetition rate exceeding 1 kHz if the “pulse duration” is less than 100 ns; CO “lasers” controlled by 6A005.d.2 having a CW maximum rated single or multimode output power not exceeding 10 kW; CO_{2} or CO/CO_{2} “lasers” controlled by 6A005.d.3 having an output wavelength in the range from 9,000 to 11,000 nm and having a pulsed output not exceeding 2 J per pulse and a maximum rated average single or multimode output power not exceeding 5 kW; and CO_{2} “lasers” controlled by 6A005.d.3 that operate in CW multiple-transverse mode, and having a CW output power not exceeding 15 kW.

text.zh: 受管制物项清单
text.en: List of Items Controlled

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 本条目管制物项的“软件”见ECCN 6D001。(2) 本条目管制物项的技术见ECCN 6E001（“开发”）、6E002（“生产”）和6E201（“使用”）。(3) 另见ECCN 6A205和6A995。(4) 为光刻设备“专门设计”的准分子“激光器”，见ECCN 3B001。(5) 为用于同位素分离而“特别设计”或制备的“激光器”，受核管理委员会出口许可权限管辖（见10 CFR第110部分）。(6) 受ITAR管辖的激光系统或激光器，见USML第XII(b)和(e)类。(7) 受ITAR管辖的某些基于激光的定向能武器系统、设备和部件，见USML第XVIII类。
text.en: Related Controls (1) See ECCN 6D001 for “software” for items controlled under this entry. (2) See ECCNs 6E001 (“development”), 6E002 (“production”), and 6E201 (“use”) for technology for items controlled under this entry. (3) Also see ECCNs 6A205 and 6A995. (4) See ECCN 3B001 for excimer “lasers” “specially designed” for lithography equipment. (5) “Lasers” “especially designed” or prepared for use in isotope separation are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110). (6) See USML Category XII(b) and (e) for laser systems or lasers subject to the ITAR. (7) See USML Category XVIII for certain laser-based directed energy weapon systems, equipment, and components subject to the ITAR.

text.zh: 相关定义：就6A005而言：(1) “电光效率”定义为“激光器”输出功率（或“平均输出功率”）与运行该“激光器”所需总电输入功率之比，包括电源/电力调节及温度调节/热交换器，见6A005.a.6.b.1和6A005.b.6；(2) “非重复脉冲”指产生单个输出脉冲，或脉冲间时间间隔超过一分钟的“激光器”，见6A005注2和6A005.d.6。
text.en: Related Definitions: For the purposes of 6A005: (1) 'Wall-plug efficiency' is defined as the ratio of “laser” output power (or “average output power”) to total electrical input power required to operate the “laser”, including the power supply/conditioning and thermal conditioning/heat exchanger, see 6A005.a.6.b.1 and 6A005.b.6; (2) 'Non-repetitive pulsed' refers to “lasers” that produce either a single output pulse or that have a time interval between pulses exceeding one minute, see Note 2 of 6A005 and 6A005.d.6.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Notes:

text.zh: 1. 脉冲“激光器”包括以连续波（CW）模式运行并叠加脉冲的激光器。
text.en: 1. Pulsed “lasers” include those that run in a continuous wave (CW) mode with pulses superimposed.

text.zh: 2. 准分子、半导体、化学、CO、CO^{2}以及“非重复脉冲”钕玻璃“激光器”仅由6A005.d列明。
text.en: 2. Excimer, semiconductor, chemical, CO, CO^{2}, and 'non-repetitive pulsed' Nd:glass “lasers” are only specified by 6A005.d.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A005注2而言，“非重复脉冲”指产生单个输出脉冲，或脉冲间时间间隔超过一分钟的“激光器”。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A005 Note 2, 'non-repetitive pulsed' refers to “lasers” that produce either a single output pulse or that have a time interval between pulses exceeding one minute.

text.zh: 3. 6A005包括光纤“激光器”。
text.en: 3. 6A005 includes fiber “lasers”.

text.zh: 4. 对于通过一台“激光器”泵浦另一台“激光器”以外的手段进行频率转换（即波长改变）的“激光器”，其管制状态通过同时对源“激光器”输出及频率转换后的光学输出应用管制参数来确定。
text.en: 4. The control status of “lasers” incorporating frequency conversion (i.e., wavelength change) by means other than one “laser” pumping another “laser” is determined by applying the control parameters for both the output of the source “laser” and the frequency-converted optical output.

text.zh: 5. 6A005不管制下列“激光器”：
text.en: 5. 6A005 does not control “lasers” as follows:

text.zh: a. 输出能量低于20 J的红宝石激光器；
text.en: a. Ruby with output energy below 20 J;

text.zh: b. 氮激光器；
text.en: b. Nitrogen;

text.zh: c. 氪激光器。
text.en: c. Krypton.

text.zh: 6. 就6A005.a和6A005.b而言，“单横模”指光束轮廓的M^{2}因子小于1.3的“激光器”，“多横模”指光束轮廓的M^{2}因子为1.3或以上的“激光器”。
text.en: 6. For the purposes of 6A005.a and 6A005.b, 'single transverse mode' refers to “lasers” with a beam profile having an M^{2}-factor of less than 1.3, while 'multiple transverse mode' refers to “lasers” with a beam profile having an M^{2}-factor of 1.3 or higher

text.zh: a. 具有下列任一特性的非“可调谐”连续波“（CW）激光器”：
text.en: a. Non-“tunable” continuous wave “(CW) lasers” having any of the following:

text.zh: a.1. 输出波长小于150 nm且输出功率超过1 W；
text.en: a.1. Output wavelength less than 150 nm and output power exceeding 1W;

text.zh: a.2. 输出波长为150 nm或以上但不超过510 nm，且输出功率超过30 W；
text.en: a.2. Output wavelength of 150 nm or more but not exceeding 510 nm and output power exceeding 30 W;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A005.a.2不管制输出功率小于或等于50 W的氩“激光器”。
text.en: 6A005.a.2 does not control Argon “lasers” having an output power equal to or less than 50 W.

text.zh: a.3. 输出波长大于510 nm但不超过540 nm，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: a.3. Output wavelength exceeding 510 nm but not exceeding 540 nm and any of the following:

text.zh: a.3.a. “单横模”输出且输出功率超过50 W；或
text.en: a.3.a. 'Single transverse mode' output and output power exceeding 50 W; or

text.zh: a.3.b. “多横模”输出且输出功率超过150 W；
text.en: a.3.b. 'Multiple transverse mode' output and output power exceeding 150 W;

text.zh: a.4. 输出波长大于540 nm但不超过800 nm，且输出功率超过30 W；
text.en: a.4. Output wavelength exceeding 540 nm but not exceeding 800 nm and output power exceeding 30 W;

text.zh: a.5. 输出波长大于800 nm但不超过975 nm，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: a.5. Output wavelength exceeding 800 nm but not exceeding 975 nm and any of the following:

text.zh: a.5.a. “单横模”输出且输出功率超过50 W；或
text.en: a.5.a. 'Single transverse mode' output and output power exceeding 50 W; or

text.zh: a.5.b. “多横模”输出且输出功率超过80 W；
text.en: a.5.b. 'Multiple transverse mode' output and output power exceeding 80 W;

text.zh: a.6. 输出波长大于975 nm但不超过1,150 nm，且具有下列任一特性；
text.en: a.6. Output wavelength exceeding 975 nm but not exceeding 1,150 nm and any of the following;

text.zh: a.6.a. “单横模”输出且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: a.6.a. 'Single transverse mode' output and any of the following:

text.zh: a.6.a.1. 输出功率超过1,000 W；或
text.en: a.6.a.1. Output power exceeding 1,000 W; or

text.zh: a.6.a.2. 同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: a.6.a.2. Having all of the following:

text.zh: a.6.a.2.a. 输出功率超过500 W；以及
text.en: a.6.a.2.a. Output power exceeding 500 W; and

text.zh: a.6.a.2.b. 频谱带宽小于40 GHz；或
text.en: a.6.a.2.b. Spectral bandwidth less than 40 GHz; or

text.zh: a.6.b. “多横模”输出且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: a.6.b. 'Multiple transverse mode' output and any of the following:

text.zh: a.6.b.1. “电光效率”超过18%且输出功率超过1,000 W；或
text.en: a.6.b.1. 'Wall-plug efficiency' exceeding 18% and output power exceeding 1,000 W; or

text.zh: a.6.b.2. 输出功率超过2 kW；
text.en: a.6.b.2. Output power exceeding 2 kW;
Note 1:

text.zh: 6A005.a.6.b不管制输出功率超过2 kW但不超过6 kW、且总质量大于1,200 kg的“多横模”工业“激光器”。就本注而言，总质量包括运行“激光器”所需的所有“部件”，例如“激光器”、电源和热交换器，但不包括用于光束调节或传输的外部光学器件。
text.en: 6A005.a.6.b does not control 'multiple transverse mode', industrial “lasers” with output power exceeding 2 kW and not exceeding 6 kW with a total mass greater than 1,200 kg. For the purpose of this note, total mass includes all “components” required to operate the “laser,” e.g., “laser,” power supply, heat exchanger, but excludes external optics for beam conditioning or delivery.
Note 2:

text.zh: 6A005.a.6.b不适用于具有下列任一特性的“多横模”工业“激光器”：
text.en: 6A005.a.6.b does not apply to 'multiple transverse mode', industrial “lasers” having any of the following:

text.zh: a. ［保留］；
text.en: a. [Reserved];

text.zh: b. 输出功率超过1 kW但不超过1.6 kW，且BPP超过1.25 mm·mrad；
text.en: b. Output power exceeding 1 kW but not exceeding 1.6 kW and having a BPP exceeding 1.25 mm·mrad;

text.zh: c. 输出功率超过1.6 kW但不超过2.5 kW，且BPP超过1.7 mm·mrad；
text.en: c. Output power exceeding 1.6 kW but not exceeding 2.5 kW and having a BPP exceeding 1.7 mm·mrad;

text.zh: d. 输出功率超过2.5 kW但不超过3.3 kW，且BPP超过2.5 mm·mrad；
text.en: d. Output power exceeding 2.5 kW but not exceeding 3.3 kW and having a BPP exceeding 2.5 mm·mrad;

text.zh: e. 输出功率超过3.3 kW但不超过6 kW，且BPP超过3.5 mm·mrad；
text.en: e. Output power exceeding 3.3 kW but not exceeding 6 kW and having a BPP exceeding 3.5 mm·mrad;

text.zh: f. [保留]
text.en: f. [Reserved]

text.zh: g. [保留]
text.en: g. [Reserved]

text.zh: h. 输出功率超过6 kW但不超过8 kW，且BPP超过12 mm·mrad；或
text.en: h. Output power exceeding 6 kW but not exceeding 8 kW and having a BPP exceeding 12 mm·mrad; or

text.zh: i. 输出功率超过8 kW但不超过10 kW，且BPP超过24 mm·mrad；
text.en: i. Output power exceeding 8 kW but not exceeding 10 kW and having a BPP exceeding 24 mm·mrad;

text.zh: a.7. 输出波长大于1,150 nm但不超过1,555 nm，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: a.7. Output wavelength exceeding 1,150 nm but not exceeding 1,555 nm and any of the following:

text.zh: a.7.a. “单横模”且输出功率超过50 W；或
text.en: a.7.a. 'Single transverse mode' and output power exceeding 50 W; or

text.zh: a.7.b. “多横模”且输出功率超过80 W；
text.en: a.7.b. 'Multiple transverse mode' and output power exceeding 80 W;

text.zh: a.8. 输出波长大于1,555 nm但不超过1,850 nm，且输出功率超过1 W；
text.en: a.8. Output wavelength exceeding 1,555 nm but not exceeding 1,850 nm and output power exceeding 1 W;

text.zh: a.9. 输出波长大于1,850 nm但不超过2,100 nm，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: a.9. Output wavelength exceeding 1,850 nm but not exceeding 2,100 nm, and any of the following:

text.zh: a.9.a. “单横模”且输出功率超过1 W；或

text.en: d.1.d.1.d. Peak pulsed 'power density' exceeding 2,500 W/cm^{2}; or

text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A005.d.1.d.1.d不适用于通过外延制造的单片器件。

text.zh: d.1.d.1.e. 空间相干平均或连续波总输出功率大于150 W；
text.en: d.1.d.1.e. Spatially coherent average or CW total output power, greater than 150 W;

text.zh: d.1.d.2. 波长大于或等于1,400 nm但小于1,900 nm，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.1.d.2. Wavelength greater than or equal to 1,400 nm but less than 1,900 nm, and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1.d.2.a. 平均或连续波总输出功率小于250 W，且平均或连续波输出“功率密度”大于150 W/cm2；
text.en: d.1.d.2.a. Average or CW total output power less than 250 W and average or CW output 'power density' greater than 150 W/cm2;

text.zh: d.1.d.2.b. 平均或连续波总输出功率大于或等于250 W但小于或等于500 W，且平均或连续波输出“功率密度”大于50 W/cm^{2}；
text.en: d.1.d.2.b. Average or CW total output power equal to or exceeding 250 W but less than or equal to 500 W, and having average or CW output 'power density' greater than 50W/cm^{2};

text.zh: d.1.d.2.c. 平均或连续波总输出功率超过500 W；
text.en: d.1.d.2.c. Average or CW total output power exceeding 500 W;

text.zh: d.1.d.2.d. 峰值脉冲“功率密度”超过500 W/cm^{2}；或
text.en: d.1.d.2.d. Peak pulsed 'power density' exceeding 500 W/cm^{2}; or

text.en: Note:

text.en: 6A005.d.1.d.2.d does not apply to epitaxially-fabricated monolithic devices.

text.en: d.1.d.2.e. Spatially coherent average or CW total output power, exceeding 15 W;

text.zh: d.1.d.3. 波长大于或等于1,900 nm，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.1.d.3. Wavelength greater than or equal to 1,900 nm and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1.d.3.a. 平均或连续波输出“功率密度”大于50 W/cm^{2}；
text.en: d.1.d.3.a. Average or CW output 'power density' greater than 50 W/cm^{2};

text.zh: d.1.d.3.b. 平均或连续波输出功率大于10 W；或
text.en: d.1.d.3.b. Average or CW output power greater than 10 W; or

text.zh: d.1.d.3.c. 空间相干平均或连续波总输出功率超过1.5 W；或
text.en: d.1.d.3.c. Spatially coherent average or CW total output power, exceeding 1.5 W; or

text.zh: d.1.d.4. 至少含有一个6A005.d.1.c所列“激光器”“巴条”；
text.en: d.1.d.4. At least one “laser” 'bar' specified by 6A005.d.1.c;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A005.d.1.d而言，“功率密度”指“激光器”总输出功率除以“叠阵”的发射表面积。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A005.d.1.d, 'power density' means the total “laser” output power divided by the emitter surface area of the 'stacked array'.

text.zh: d.1.e. 6A005.d.1.d所列以外、同时具有以下全部特性的半导体“激光器”“叠阵”：
text.en: d.1.e. Semiconductor “laser” 'stacked arrays', other than those specified by 6A005.d.1.d, having all of the following:

text.zh: d.1.e.1. 为与其他“叠阵”组合形成更大“叠阵”而“专门设计”或改装；以及
text.en: d.1.e.1. “Specially designed” or modified to be combined with other 'stacked arrays' to form a larger 'stacked array'; and

text.zh: d.1.e.2. 具有电子和冷却共同使用的集成连接；
text.en: d.1.e.2. Integrated connections, common for both electronics and cooling;
Note 1:

text.zh: 通过组合6A005.d.1.e所列半导体“激光器”“叠阵”而形成、且并非设计为进一步组合或改装的“叠阵”，由6A005.d.1.d列明。
text.en: 'Stacked arrays', formed by combining semiconductor “laser” 'stacked arrays' specified by 6A005.d.1.e, that are not designed to be further combined or modified are specified by 6A005.d.1.d.
Note 2:

text.zh: 通过组合6A005.d.1.e所列半导体“激光器”“叠阵”而形成、且设计为进一步组合或改装的“叠阵”，由6A005.d.1.e列明。
text.en: 'Stacked arrays', formed by combining semiconductor “laser” 'stacked arrays' specified by 6A005.d.1.e, that are designed to be further combined or modified are specified by 6A005.d.1.e.
Note 3:

text.zh: 6A005.d.1.e不适用于由单个“巴条”构成、设计为制造成首尾相连堆叠线性阵列的模块化组件。
text.en: 6A005.d.1.e does not apply to modular assemblies of single 'bars' designed to be fabricated into end to end stacked linear arrays.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 就6A005.d.1.e而言：
text.en: For the purposes of 6A005.d.1.e:

text.zh: 1. 半导体“激光器”通常称为“激光”二极管。
text.en: 1. Semiconductor “lasers” are commonly called “laser” diodes.

text.zh: 2. “巴条”（也称半导体“激光器”“巴条”、“激光”二极管“巴条”或二极管“巴条”）由多个半导体“激光器”组成一维阵列。
text.en: 2. A 'bar' (also called a semiconductor “laser” 'bar', a “laser” diode 'bar' or diode 'bar') consists of multiple semiconductor “lasers” in a one-dimensional array.

text.zh: 3. “叠阵”由多个“巴条”组成，形成半导体“激光器”的二维阵列。
text.en: 3. A 'stacked array' consists of multiple 'bars' forming a two-dimensional array of semiconductor “lasers”.

text.zh: d.2. 具有下列任一特性的一氧化碳（CO）“激光器”：
text.en: d.2. Carbon monoxide (CO) “lasers” having any of the following:

text.en: d.2.a. Output energy exceeding 2 J per pulse and “peak power” exceeding 5 kW; or

text.en: d.3.a. CW output power exceeding 15 kW;

text.zh: d.3.b. 脉冲输出的“脉冲持续时间”超过10 µs，且具有下列任一特性：

text.zh: d.3.b.1. “平均输出功率”超过10 kW；或
text.en: d.3.b.1. “Average output power” exceeding 10 kW; or

text.zh: d.3.b.2. “峰值功率”超过100 kW；或
text.en: d.3.b.2. “Peak power” exceeding 100 kW; or

text.zh: d.3.c. 脉冲输出的“脉冲持续时间”小于或等于10 µs，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.3.c. Pulsed output with a “pulse duration” equal to or less than 10 µs and any of the following:

text.zh: d.3.c.1. 每脉冲能量超过5 J；或
text.en: d.3.c.1. Pulse energy exceeding 5 J per pulse; or

text.zh: d.3.c.2. “平均输出功率”超过2.5 kW；
text.en: d.3.c.2. “Average output power” exceeding 2.5 kW;

text.zh: d.4. 具有下列任一特性的准分子“激光器”：
text.en: d.4. Excimer “lasers” having any of the following:

text.zh: d.4.a. 输出波长不超过150 nm，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.4.a. Output wavelength not exceeding 150 nm and any of the following:

text.zh: d.4.a.1. 每脉冲输出能量超过50 mJ；或
text.en: d.4.a.1. Output energy exceeding 50 mJ per pulse; or

text.zh: d.4.a.2. “平均输出功率”超过1 W；
text.en: d.4.a.2. “Average output power” exceeding 1 W;

text.zh: d.4.b. 输出波长大于150 nm但不超过190 nm，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.4.b. Output wavelength exceeding 150 nm but not exceeding 190 nm and any of the following:

text.zh: d.4.b.1. 每脉冲输出能量超过1.5 J；或
text.en: d.4.b.1. Output energy exceeding 1.5 J per pulse; or

text.zh: d.4.b.2. “平均输出功率”超过120 W；
text.en: d.4.b.2. “Average output power” exceeding 120 W;

text.en: d.4.c. Output wavelength exceeding 190 nm but not exceeding 360 nm and any of the following:

text.zh: d.4.c.1. 每脉冲输出能量超过10 J；或
text.en: d.4.c.1. Output energy exceeding 10 J per pulse; or

text.zh: d.4.c.2. “平均输出功率”超过500 W；或
text.en: d.4.c.2. “Average output power” exceeding 500 W; or

text.zh: d.4.d. 输出波长大于360 nm，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.4.d. Output wavelength exceeding 360 nm and any of the following:

text.zh: d.4.d.1. 每脉冲输出能量超过1.5 J；或
text.en: d.4.d.1. Output energy exceeding 1.5 J per pulse; or

text.zh: d.4.d.2. “平均输出功率”超过30 W；
text.en: d.4.d.2. “Average output power” exceeding 30 W;

text.en: Note:

text.en: For excimer “lasers” “specially designed” for lithography equipment, see 3B001.

text.en: d.5. “Chemical lasers” as follows:

text.en: d.5.a. Hydrogen Fluoride (HF) “lasers';

text.en: d.5.c.2. Deuterium Fluoride-Carbon dioxide (DF-CO_{2}) “lasers”;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A005.d.5.c而言，“转移激光器”是指通过非激光跃迁原子或分子与激光跃迁原子或分子碰撞传递能量，激发激光工作物质的“激光器”。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A005.d.5.c, 'transfer lasers' are “lasers” in which the lasing species are excited through the transfer of energy by collision of a non-lasing atom or molecule with a lasing atom or molecule species.

text.zh: d.6. 具有下列任一特性的“非重复脉冲”钕（Nd）玻璃“激光器”：
text.en: d.6. 'Non-repetitive pulsed' Neodymium (Nd) glass “lasers” having any of the following:

text.zh: d.6.a. “脉冲持续时间”不超过1 µs且每脉冲输出能量超过50 J；或
text.en: d.6.a. A “pulse duration” not exceeding 1 µs and output energy exceeding 50 J per pulse; or

text.zh: d.6.b. “脉冲持续时间”超过1 µs且每脉冲输出能量超过100 J；
text.en: d.6.b. A “pulse duration” exceeding 1 µs and output energy exceeding 100 J per pulse;

text.zh: e. 下列“部件”：
text.en: e. “Components” as follows:

text.zh: e.1. 采用“主动冷却”或热管冷却的反射镜；
text.en: e.1. Mirrors cooled either by 'active cooling' or by heat pipe cooling;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A005.e.1而言，“主动冷却”是一种光学“部件”冷却技术，利用光学部件表层下方（标称距光学表面小于1 mm）流动的流体从光学器件移除热量。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A005.e.1, 'active cooling' is a cooling technique for optical “components” using flowing fluids within the subsurface (nominally less than 1 mm below the optical surface) of the optical component to remove heat from the optic.

text.zh: e.2. 为与受管制“激光器”配合使用而“专门设计”的光学反射镜，或透射或部分透射光学或电光“部件”，但熔融拉锥光纤合束器和多层介质光栅（MLD）除外；
text.en: e.2. Optical mirrors or transmissive or partially transmissive optical or electro-optical-”components,” other than fused tapered fiber combiners and Multi-Layer Dielectric gratings (MLDs), “specially designed” for use with controlled “lasers”;
Note to 6A005.e.2:

text.zh: 光纤合束器和MLD由6A005.e.3列明。
text.en: Fiber combiners and MLDs are specified by 6A005.e.3.

text.en: e.3. Fiber “laser” “components” as follows:

text.zh: e.3.a. 同时具有以下全部特性的多模至多模熔融拉锥光纤合束器：

text.en: e.3.a.1. An insertion loss better (less) than or equal to 0.3 dB maintained at a rated total average or CW output power (excluding output power transmitted through the single mode core if present) exceeding 1,000 W; and

text.zh: e.3.a.2. 输入光纤数量大于或等于3；
text.en: e.3.a.2. Number of input fibers equal to or greater than 3;

text.zh: e.3.b. 同时具有以下全部特性的单模至多模熔融拉锥光纤合束器：
text.en: e.3.b. Single mode to multimode fused tapered fiber combiners having all of the following:

text.zh: e.3.b.1. 在额定总平均或连续波输出功率超过4,600 W时，维持优于（小于）0.5 dB的插入损耗；
text.en: e.3.b.1. An insertion loss better (less) than 0.5 dB maintained at a rated total average or CW output power exceeding 4,600 W;

text.zh: e.3.b.2. 输入光纤数量大于或等于3；以及
text.en: e.3.b.2. Number of input fibers equal to or greater than 3; and

text.zh: e.3.b.3. 具有下列任一特性：
text.en: e.3.b.3. Having any of the following:

text.zh: e.3.b.3.a. 输入光纤数量小于或等于5时，在输出端测得的光束参数积（BPP）不超过1.5 mm mrad；或
text.en: e.3.b.3.a. A Beam Parameter Product (BPP) measured at the output not exceeding 1.5 mm mrad for a number of input fibers less than or equal to 5; or

text.zh: e.3.b.3.b. 输入光纤数量大于5时，在输出端测得的BPP不超过2.5 mm mrad；
text.en: e.3.b.3.b. A BPP measured at the output not exceeding 2.5 mm mrad for a number of input fibers greater than 5;

text.zh: e.3.c. 同时具有以下全部特性的MLD：

text.en: e.3.c.1. Designed for spectral or coherent beam combination of 5 or more fiber “lasers;” and

text.zh: e.3.c.2. 连续波“激光”诱导损伤阈值（LIDT）大于或等于10 kW/cm^{2}；
text.en: e.3.c.2. CW “Laser” Induced Damage Threshold (LIDT) greater than or equal to 10 kW/cm^{2};

text.zh: g. 同时具有以下全部特性的“激光声探测设备”：
text.en: g. 'Laser acoustic detection equipment' having all of the following:

text.en: g.4. Optical system resolution better (less) than 1 nm; and

text.zh: g.5. 光学信噪比大于或等于10^{3}。

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 下列“磁力计”和子系统：
text.en: a. “Magnetometers” and subsystems, as follows:

text.zh: a.1. 采用“超导”（SQUID）“技术”且具有下列任一特性的“磁力计”：
text.en: a.1. “Magnetometers” using “superconductive” (SQUID) “technology” and having any of the following:

text.zh: a.1.a. 为静止运行设计、不带为降低运动噪声而“专门设计”的子系统，且在1 Hz频率下“灵敏度”等于或低于（优于）50 fT（rms）/√Hz的SQUID系统；或
text.en: a.1.a. SQUID systems designed for stationary operation, without “specially designed” subsystems designed to reduce in-motion noise, and having a 'sensitivity' equal to or lower (better) than 50 fT (rms) per square root Hz at a frequency of 1 Hz; or

text.zh: a.1.b. 在1 Hz频率下运动中磁力计“灵敏度”低于（优于）20 pT（rms）/√Hz，且为降低运动噪声而“专门设计”的SQUID系统；
text.en: a.1.b. SQUID systems having an in-motion-magnetometer 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 20 pT (rms) per square root Hz at a frequency of 1 Hz and “specially designed” to reduce in-motion noise;

text.zh: a.2. 采用光泵或核旋进（质子/Overhauser）“技术”，且在1 Hz频率下“灵敏度”低于（优于）20 pT（rms）/√Hz的“磁力计”；
text.en: a.2. “Magnetometers” using optically pumped or nuclear precession (proton/Overhauser) “technology” having a 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 20 pT (rms) per square root Hz at a frequency of 1 Hz;

text.zh: a.3. 采用磁通门“技术”，且在1 Hz频率下“灵敏度”等于或低于（优于）10 pT（rms）/√Hz的“磁力计”；
text.en: a.3. “Magnetometers” using fluxgate “technology” having a 'sensitivity' equal to or lower (better) than 10 pT (rms) per square root Hz at a frequency of 1 Hz;

text.zh: a.4. “灵敏度”低于（优于）下列任一值的感应线圈“磁力计”：
text.en: a.4. Induction coil “magnetometers” having a 'sensitivity' lower (better) than any of the following:

text.zh: a.4.a. 频率小于1 Hz时为0.05 nT（rms）/√Hz；
text.en: a.4.a. 0.05 nT (rms)/square root Hz at frequencies of less than 1 Hz;

text.zh: a.4.b. 频率为1 Hz或以上但不超过10 Hz时为1 × 10^{−3} nT（rms）/√Hz；或
text.en: a.4.b. 1 × 10^{−3} nT (rms)/square root Hz at frequencies of 1 Hz or more but not exceeding 10 Hz; or

text.zh: a.4.c. 频率超过10 Hz时为1 × 10^{−4} nT（rms）/√Hz；
text.en: a.4.c. 1 × 10^{−4} nT (rms)/square root Hz at frequencies exceeding 10 Hz;

text.zh: a.5. “灵敏度”低于（优于）1 nT（rms）/√Hz的光纤“磁力计”；
text.en: a.5. Fiber optic “magnetometers” having a 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 1 nT (rms) per square root Hz;

text.zh: b. 在1 Hz下测量时，“灵敏度”低于（优于）8纳伏/米/√Hz的水下电场传感器；
text.en: b. Underwater electric field sensors having a 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 8 nanovolt per meter per square root Hz when measured at 1 Hz;

text.zh: c. 下列“磁梯度计”：
text.en: c. “Magnetic gradiometers” as follows:

text.zh: c.1. 采用多个6A006.a管制“磁力计”的“磁梯度计”；
text.en: c.1. “Magnetic gradiometers” using multiple “magnetometers” controlled by 6A006.a;

text.zh: c.2. 磁场梯度“灵敏度”低于（优于）0.3 nT/m（rms）/√Hz的光纤“本征磁梯度计”；
text.en: c.2. Fiber optic “intrinsic magnetic gradiometers” having a magnetic gradient field 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 0.3 nT/m (rms) per square root Hz;

text.zh: c.3. 采用光纤“技术”以外“技术”，且磁场梯度“灵敏度”低于（优于）0.015 nT/m（rms）/√Hz的“本征磁梯度计”；
text.en: c.3. “Intrinsic magnetic gradiometers”, using “technology” other than fiber-optic “technology”, having a magnetic gradient field 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 0.015 nT/m (rms) per square root Hz;

text.zh: d. 使性能达到或优于6A006.a、6A006.b和6A006.c管制参数的磁场和水下电场传感器“补偿系统”；以及
text.en: d. “Compensation systems” for magnetic and underwater electric field sensors resulting in a performance equal to or better than the control parameters of 6A006.a, 6A006.b, and 6A006.c; and

text.zh: e. 采用6A006.a所列磁场传感器或6A006.b所列水下电场传感器的水下电磁接收机。
text.en: e. Underwater electromagnetic receivers incorporating magnetic field sensors specified by 6A006.a or underwater electric field sensors specified by 6A006.b.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A006而言，“灵敏度”（噪声水平）是设备自身限制的噪声本底的均方根值，该噪声本底即能够测量的最低信号。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A006, 'sensitivity' (noise level) is the root mean square of the device-limited noise floor which is the lowest signal that can be measured.

text.en: b.1. A static “accuracy” of less (better) than 0.7 mGal; and

text.zh: b.2. 使用中（运行）“准确度”小于（优于）0.7 mGal，在任何随附校正补偿和运动影响组合下，“达到稳态记录的时间”小于2分钟；
text.en: b.2. An in-service (operational) “accuracy” of less (better) than 0.7 mGal having a 'time-to-steady-state registration' of less than 2 minutes under any combination of attendant corrective compensations and motional influences;

text.zh: 技术注：

text.zh: 就6A007.b.2而言，“达到稳态记录的时间”（也称重力仪响应时间）是减小平台引起的加速度（高频噪声）干扰效应所需的时间。

text.en: —Precision Approach Radar (PAR) equipment conforming to ICAO standards and employing electronically steerable linear (1-dimensional) arrays or mechanically positioned passive antennas.

text.zh: a. 工作频率为40 GHz至230 GHz，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: a. Operating at frequencies from 40 GHz to 230 GHz and having any of the following:

text.zh: a.1. 平均输出功率超过100 mW；或
text.en: a.1. An average output power exceeding 100 mW; or

text.en: a.2. Locating “accuracy” of 1 m or less (better) in range and 0.2 degree or less (better) in azimuth;

text.zh: b. 可调谐带宽超过“中心工作频率”的±6.25%；

text.zh: c. 能够同时在两个以上载波频率上工作；
text.en: c. Capable of operating simultaneously on more than two carrier frequencies;

text.zh: d. 能够以合成孔径（SAR）、逆合成孔径（ISAR）雷达模式或机载侧视（SLAR）雷达模式运行；
text.en: d. Capable of operating in synthetic aperture (SAR), inverse synthetic aperture (ISAR) radar mode, or sidelooking airborne (SLAR) radar mode;

text.zh: e. 采用电子扫描阵列天线；
text.en: e. Incorporating electronically scanned array antennae;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A008.e而言，电子扫描阵列天线也称电子可操纵阵列天线。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A008.e, electronically scanned array antennae are also known as electronically steerable array antennae.

text.zh: f. 能够对非合作目标进行测高；
text.en: f. Capable of heightfinding non-cooperative targets;

text.zh: g. 为机载（气球或机体安装）运行而“专门设计”，且具有用于探测移动目标的多普勒“信号处理”；
text.en: g. “Specially designed” for airborne (balloon or airframe mounted) operation and having Doppler “signal processing” for the detection of moving targets;

text.zh: h. 采用雷达信号处理且使用下列任一技术：
text.en: h. Employing processing of radar signals and using any of the following:

text.zh: h.1. “雷达扩频”技术；或
text.en: h.1. “Radar spread spectrum” techniques; or

text.zh: h.2. “雷达频率捷变”技术；
text.en: h.2. “Radar frequency agility” techniques;

text.zh: i. 可在地面运行，最大“仪器显示距离”超过185 km；
text.en: i. Providing ground-based operation with a maximum 'instrumented range' exceeding 185 km;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A008.i不管制：
text.en: 6A008.i does not control:

text.zh: a. 渔场监视雷达；
text.en: a. Fishing ground surveillance radar;

text.zh: b. 为航路空中交通管制“专门设计”，且同时具有以下全部特性的地面雷达设备：
text.en: b. Ground radar equipment “specially designed” for en route air traffic control, and having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 最大“仪器显示距离”为500 km或以下；
text.en: 1. A maximum 'instrumented range' of 500 km or less;

text.zh: 2. 配置为雷达目标数据仅能从雷达站向一个或多个民用ATC中心单向传输；
text.en: 2. Configured so that radar target data can be transmitted only one way from the radar site to one or more civil ATC centers;

text.zh: 3. 不具备从航路ATC中心远程控制雷达扫描速率的功能；以及
text.en: 3. Contains no provisions for remote control of the radar scan rate from the en route ATC center; and

text.zh: 4. 永久安装；
text.en: 4. Permanently installed;

text.zh: c. 气象气球跟踪雷达。
text.en: c. Weather balloon tracking radars.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A008.i而言，“仪器显示距离”是雷达规定的无模糊显示距离。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A008.i, 'instrumented range' is the specified unambiguous display range of a radar.

text.zh: j. 属于“激光”雷达或光探测与测距（LIDAR）设备，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: j. Being “laser” radar or Light Detection and Ranging (LIDAR) equipment and having any of the following:

text.zh: j.1. “航天级”；
text.en: j.1. “Space-qualified”;

text.zh: j.2. 采用相干外差或零差探测技术，且角分辨率小于（优于）20 µrad（微弧度）；或
text.en: j.2. Employing coherent heterodyne or homodyne detection techniques and having an angular resolution of less (better) than 20 µrad (microradians); or

text.zh: j.3. 设计为按国际海道测量组织（IHO）《海道测量标准》1a等标准（第5版，2008年2月）或更高标准执行机载近岸水深测量，并使用一个或多个波长大于400 nm但不超过600 nm的“激光器”；
text.en: j.3. Designed for carrying out airborne bathymetric littoral surveys to International Hydrographic Organization (IHO) Order 1a Standard (5th Edition February 2008) for Hydrographic Surveys or better, and using one or more “lasers” with a wavelength exceeding 400 nm but not exceeding 600 nm;
Note 1:

text.zh: 为测绘“专门设计”的LIDAR设备仅由6A008.j.3列明。
text.en: LIDAR equipment “specially designed” for surveying is only specified by 6A008.j.3.
Note 2:

text.zh: 6A008.j不适用于为气象观测“专门设计”的LIDAR设备。
text.en: 6A008.j does not apply to LIDAR equipment “specially designed” for meteorological observation.
Note 3:

text.zh: IHO 1a等标准（第5版，2008年2月）中的参数概述如下：
text.en: Parameters in the IHO Order 1a Standard 5th Edition February 2008 are summarized as follows:

text.zh: 水平准确度（95%置信水平）= 5 m + 深度的5%。
text.en: Horizontal Accuracy (95% Confidence Level)= 5 m + 5% of depth.

text.zh: 归算水深的深度准确度（95%置信水平）= ±√(a^{2} + (b*d)^{2})，其中：
text.en: Depth Accuracy for Reduced Depths (95% confidence level) = ±√(a^{2} + (b*d)^{2}) where:

text.zh: a = 0.5 m = 恒定深度误差，即全部恒定深度误差之和
text.en: a = 0.5 m = constant depth error, i.e., the sum of all constant depth errors

text.zh: b = 0.013 = 随深度变化误差的系数
text.en: b = 0.013 = factor of depth dependent error

text.zh: b*d = 随深度变化的误差，即全部随深度变化误差之和
text.en: b*d = depth dependent error, i.e., the sum of all depth dependent errors

text.zh: d = 深度
text.en: d = depth

text.zh: 地物探测 = 深度不超过40 m时，大于2 m的立方体地物；深度超过40 m时，为深度的10%。
text.en: Feature Detection = Cubic features > 2 m in depths up to 40 m; 10% of depth beyond 40 m.

text.zh: k. 具有采用“脉冲压缩”的“信号处理”子系统，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: k. Having “signal processing” sub-systems using “pulse compression” and having any of the following:

text.zh: k.1. “脉冲压缩”比超过150；或
text.en: k.1. A “pulse compression” ratio exceeding 150; or

text.zh: k.2. 压缩后脉冲宽度小于200 ns；或
text.en: k.2. A compressed pulse width of less than 200 ns; or

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A008.k.2不适用于同时具有以下全部特性的二维“船用雷达”或“船舶交通服务”雷达：
text.en: 6A008.k.2 does not apply to two dimensional 'marine radar' or 'vessel traffic service' radar, having all of the following:

text.zh: a. “脉冲压缩”比不超过150；
text.en: a. “Pulse compression” ratio not exceeding 150;

text.zh: b. 压缩后脉冲宽度大于30 ns；
text.en: b. Compressed pulse width of greater than 30 ns;

text.zh: c. 单个旋转机械扫描天线；
text.en: c. Single and rotating mechanically scanned antenna;

text.zh: d. 峰值输出功率不超过250 W；以及
text.en: d. Peak output power not exceeding 250 W; and

text.zh: e. 不具备“跳频”能力。
text.en: e. Not capable of “frequency hopping”.

text.zh: l. 具有数据处理子系统，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: l. Having data processing sub-systems and having any of the following:

text.zh: l.1. “自动目标跟踪”，在天线任一次旋转时提供超过下次天线波束通过时刻的预测目标位置；或
text.en: l.1. 'Automatic target tracking' providing, at any antenna rotation, the predicted target position beyond the time of the next antenna beam passage; or

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A008.l.1不管制ATC系统中的冲突告警能力或“船用雷达”。
text.en: 6A008.l.1 does not control conflict alert capability in ATC systems, or 'marine radar'.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A008.l.1而言，“自动目标跟踪”是一种实时自动确定目标最可能位置的外推值并将其作为输出提供的处理技术。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A008.l.1, 'automatic target tracking' is a processing technique that automatically determines and provides as output an extrapolated value of the most probable position of the target in real time.
l.2. [Reserved]
l.3. [Reserved]

text.zh: l.4. 配置为在六秒内对两个或以上“地理分散”的雷达传感器的目标数据进行叠加和相关或融合，以使总体性能超过6A008.f或6A008.i所列任一单独传感器的性能。
text.en: l.4. Configured to provide superposition and correlation, or fusion, of target data within six seconds from two or more 'geographically dispersed' radar sensors to improve the aggregate performance beyond that of any single sensor specified by 6A008.f, or 6A008.i.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A008.l.4而言，当每个传感器位置与任何其他位置在任一方向上的距离均超过1,500 m时，视为“地理分散”。移动传感器始终视为“地理分散”。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A008.l.4, sensors are considered 'geographically dispersed' when each location is distant from any other more than 1,500 m in any direction. Mobile sensors are always considered 'geographically dispersed'.

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 另见《美国军品清单》（22 CFR第121部分）。
text.en: See also the U.S. Munitions List (22 CFR part 121).

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A008.l不适用于为“船舶交通服务”设计的系统、设备和组件。
text.en: 6A008.l does not apply to systems, equipment and assemblies designed for 'vessel traffic services'.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就6A008而言，“船用雷达”是为在海上、内陆水道或近岸环境安全航行而设计的雷达。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 6A008, 'marine radar' is a radar that is designed to navigate safely at sea, inland waterways or near-shore environments.

text.zh: 2. 就6A008而言，“船舶交通服务”是一种类似于“航空器”空中交通管制的船舶交通监测和控制服务。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 6A008, 'vessel traffic service' is a vessel traffic monitoring and control service similar to air traffic control for “aircraft.”
